witchmod.configuration.discoverySystemEn: Whether the discovery / Compendium rumour system runs at all. When false NOTHING is ever 'discovered' (effects AND modifiers), no discovery chat alerts fire, and the Compendium shows everything as already known (no rumour pages).
witchmod.configuration.globalCostMultipl: A global multiplier on every ritual's Cursed Essence cost (1.0 = unchanged, 0.5 = half price, 2.0 = double). Stacks on top of per-effect costs and modifier deltas.
witchmod.configuration.guaranteedIfFully: When true, paying the FULL essence cost GUARANTEES success — the residual ~5% fizzle at full payment is removed. Underpaying can still fail. (ritualNeverFails is the stronger 'always succeed'.)
witchmod.configuration.disabledAttachmen: Attachment (curse/blessing) ids that are DISABLED and can never be present — e.g. "witchmod:violence" or just "violence". Every in-world route (Table, jar, coin, effigy, bell, infectious spread) refuses them; disabledAttachmentsCommandBypass decides whether op commands still can.
When true, the op commands /bewitch apply|dummy may STILL apply a disabled attachment (only the in-world routes are blocked). When false, commands are blocked too.
witchmod.configuration.disabledModifiers: Table modifier ids that are DISABLED — e.g. "dragons_breath", "clock". A disabled modifier is refused in the Table's modifier slot (no command bypass).
witchmod.configuration.ignoreClientOptOu: Players can opt out of certain client-side curses in their own client config. When this is false (the default) the server HONOURS those opt-outs — a cast of an opted-out effect on that player is refused, the caster is quietly told, and any essence is refunded. Set true to IGNORE all client opt-outs, so those curses always land regardless of the target's preference.
witchmod.configuration.specialAttachment: The secret attachments (Pandora's Box, Shadow, Cornucopia, Puppeteer). When true (the default) each stays hidden from the Compendium and from every random roll until a player has discovered every other effect of its kind (all curses / all blessings). A caster without that knowledge is warned on their first attempt, and every later attempt BACKFIRES. Set false to treat them like any other attachment: visible as rumours, rollable, and castable by anyone.
witchmod.configuration.disabledRecipes.t: Item ids whose crafting recipe is DISABLED — e.g. "witchmod:voodoo_doll". Any recipe producing a listed item is filtered out at recipe load, so it can't be crafted (loot/other routes still work). Accepts the id with or without the witchmod: namespace. Takes effect on world load or /reload.
witchmod.configuration.bannedItems.toolt: Fully BANNED item ids — any item, vanilla or modded, e.g. "minecraft:tnt" or "witchmod:voodoo_doll". A banned item cannot be crafted or smelted (its result is voided), and, with forceClearBannedItems on, is stripped from player inventories on sight. Broader than disabledRecipes, which only blocks this mod's own recipes. Accepts an id with or without its namespace.
witchmod.configuration.forceClearBannedI: When true, any bannedItems already in a player's inventory are periodically deleted, not just blocked from being made — so pre-existing stocks are cleared out too. Off by default (blocking only).
witchmod.configuration.cursesEnabled.too: Whether curses can be applied at all.
Whether blessings can be applied at all.
Whether a failed Table ritual can backfire onto the caster. When false, that probability mass falls through to a harmless fizzle instead.
When true, a Table ritual always succeeds — the slight chance of a fizzle/backfire is removed, so essence still just tunes cost, not the odds.
witchmod.configuration.wardDurabilityDec: Whether deflecting a curse costs the Ward a durability point. Set false to let players opt out of the durability tax entirely.
How many ticks after a player's first-ever join they cannot be targeted by another player's curse/blessing (self-casts are unaffected). 6000 ticks = 5 minutes. 0 disables it.
witchmod.configuration.maxActiveEffectsP: The Limit: the most curses AND the most blessings a player can carry at once. This is an ABSOLUTE hard cap — every apply path (table, jar, coin, effigy, command) refuses to exceed it (Infectious is exempt). It also doubles as the backfire-RISK threshold at the Table.
witchmod.configuration.starterDiscoveryE: Whether every player silently discovers a few starter curses/blessings the first time they join — so the Compendium isn't entirely blank to begin with. One-time, per player.
witchmod.configuration.starterDiscoveryC: Starter discovery: how many random curses to reveal on first login.
witchmod.configuration.starterDiscoveryB: Starter discovery: how many random blessings to reveal on first login.
witchmod.configuration.starterDiscoveryP: Starter discovery: only reveal effects with a power level at or above this (0-100).
Starter discovery: only reveal effects with a power level at or below this (0-100).
witchmod.configuration.ledgerRange.toolt: How far (in blocks) a Ledger block records ritual activity around it and reacts with particle feedback. Each Ledger permanently keeps its most recent casts within this range.
How many recent casts a single Ledger keeps (oldest is dropped to record a new one). Persisted with the world.
witchmod.configuration.wardingTotemRange: How far (in blocks) a Warding Totem shields players — anyone within this range of a placed totem gets the 'Protected' effect and CANNOT have any curse/blessing/voodoo applied to them.
witchmod.configuration.scryingRefreshTic: Scrying Mirror: while you keep holding, the panel re-reads the target this often so the timers stay live.
witchmod.configuration.scryingSlownessAm: Scrying Mirror: the Slowness level applied while peering (0 = Slowness I; 3 = Slowness IV — significantly slowed).
witchmod.configuration.purifyDrainTicksP: Holy (Purifying) Water: how many ticks of curse/blessing timer are burned off PER GAME TICK while a player with active effects stands in it. 20 = 1 real second of timer drained every tick (20x speed), so the timers visibly race down. Higher = faster cleanse.
witchmod.configuration.purifyRampTicks.t: Holy Water: the cleanse RAMPS the longer you soak — it starts at purifyRampMinMult of the base drain and climbs to purifyRampMaxMult over this many ticks of continuous bathing (reset when you leave the water). 400 = 20 seconds.
witchmod.configuration.purifyRampMinMult: Holy Water: the drain multiplier the instant you get in (0.5 = half the standard speed).
witchmod.configuration.purifyRampMaxMult: Holy Water: the drain multiplier once the first ramp is full (3.0 = 3x the standard speed).
Holy Water: a SECOND ramp after the first — over this many more ticks of soaking, the drain climbs from purifyRampMaxMult to DOUBLE it, so a long soak really races. 200 = 10 seconds; 0 disables it.
witchmod.configuration.holyWaterDrinkDra: Holy (Purifying) Water: ticks of timer washed off EVERY active attachment when a Thirst-cursed player DRINKS it (a clean, risk-free drink). 6000 = 5 minutes.
witchmod.configuration.purifyUndeadDamag: Holy (Purifying) Water: damage dealt to an undead mob per hit while it stands in the fluid (vanilla invulnerability frames space the hits out, so it's periodic tick damage).
witchmod.configuration.purifyShardChance: Holy Water acquisition: each Amethyst Shard right-clicked into a WATER cauldron adds this much cumulative chance for the water to turn holy (0.06 = a stacking +6% per shard).
witchmod.configuration.limitBackfireBoos: Flat backfire-chance increase (percentage points) applied when the target is already at or over maxActiveEffectsPerPlayer.
witchmod.configuration.escalatingCostPer: Extra essence cost (percent) required to cast an effect on a target who already has that exact effect active (the escalating cost).
witchmod.configuration.successFloorPerce: Section 5.7 formula: minimum success chance regardless of essence spent.
witchmod.configuration.successSpanPercen: Section 5.7 formula: how much essenceSpent/baseCost can add on top of the floor.
witchmod.configuration.successCapPercent: Section 5.7 formula: success chance never exceeds this (Netherstar modifier overrides it).
witchmod.configuration.backfireStartPerc: Section 5.7 formula: backfire chance at essenceSpent = 0, scaling down to 0 at full cost.
witchmod.configuration.backfireLowTierCo: PLACEHOLDER tier: attachments with baseCost <= this are LOW tier and never backfire (0%).
witchmod.configuration.backfireHighTierC: PLACEHOLDER tier: attachments with baseCost >= this are HIGH tier and always keep a small minimum backfire chance even at full essence.
witchmod.configuration.backfireHighTierF: PLACEHOLDER tier: the minimum backfire chance HIGH-tier attachments retain at full essence.
witchmod.configuration.backfireExplosion: Backfire (table explodes): explosion power for the weakest attachment (⚠ scaled by baseCost as a PLACEHOLDER for real attachment strength).
Backfire (table explodes): explosion power for the strongest attachment (⚠ baseCost placeholder).
witchmod.configuration.backfireDamageMin: Backfire (damage type): hearts*2 dealt for the weakest attachment (⚠ baseCost placeholder).
witchmod.configuration.backfireDamageMax: Backfire (damage type): hearts*2 dealt for the strongest attachment (⚠ baseCost placeholder).
witchmod.configuration.backfireStrengthC: ⚠ PLACEHOLDER strength scale: the baseCost mapped to the MIN end of backfire explosion/damage.
⚠ PLACEHOLDER strength scale: the baseCost mapped to the MAX end of backfire explosion/damage.
witchmod.configuration.jarSplashRadius.t: Thrown Jar: the splash radius (blocks) its stored effects hit — deliberately bigger than a vanilla splash potion.
witchmod.configuration.jarLashRange.tool: Thrown Jar (lash): if the splash catches no one, a homing lash hunts the nearest player within this range (blocks).
witchmod.configuration.jarLashSpeed.tool: Thrown Jar (lash): how fast the lash surges toward its target (blocks/tick).
witchmod.configuration.jarLashExpiryTick: Thrown Jar (lash): how long (ticks) the lash chases before it fizzles out. Run far enough and it can't reach you.
witchmod.configuration.allergicCarnivore: Allergic: time of day (0..23999, 0 = sunrise, 6000 = noon, 12000 = sunset, 18000 = midnight) from which a cast gives the CARNIVORE diet (allergic to plants). Each diet runs from its start until the next diet's start, wrapping round midnight.
witchmod.configuration.allergicVegetaria: Allergic: time of day from which a cast gives the VEGETARIAN diet (allergic to meat).
witchmod.configuration.allergicCleanEate: Allergic: time of day from which a cast gives the CLEAN EATER diet (allergic to magic food and potions).
witchmod.configuration.allergicCastMessa: Allergic: ticks after the curse lands before the caster's action bar names the allergy (so it doesn't instantly overwrite the ritual's own success message).
witchmod.configuration.allergicNutrition: Allergic: percent of the hunger AND saturation a forbidden food actually gives you (0 = nothing). Beneficial food/potion effects are always stripped.
witchmod.configuration.allergicEatTier.t: Allergic: reaction tier (1..3) caused by eating or drinking a forbidden item.
witchmod.configuration.allergicEatSecond: Allergic: how long that eating reaction lasts (seconds).
witchmod.configuration.allergicCheckInte: Allergic: ticks between exposure scans (10 = twice a second).
witchmod.configuration.allergicBlockRadi: Allergic: how close (blocks) an allergen BLOCK must be to set you off.
witchmod.configuration.allergicBlockSeco: Allergic: an allergen block only ever causes a TIER 1 reaction, lasting this long (topped up while near).
witchmod.configuration.allergicVegetaria: Allergic: blocks that set off a VEGETARIAN. Block ids, or #tags.
witchmod.configuration.allergicCarnivore: Allergic: blocks that set off a CARNIVORE. Block ids, or #tags.
witchmod.configuration.allergicCleanEate: Allergic: blocks that set off a CLEAN EATER. Block ids, or #tags.
witchmod.configuration.allergicMobRadius: Allergic: how close (blocks) a hazardous mob, player or dropped item must be to set you off.
witchmod.configuration.allergicVegetaria: Allergic: entity types that set off a VEGETARIAN. Entity ids, or #tags. (Empty by default — for vegetarians it's the meat itself: dropped meat and meat in inventories.)
witchmod.configuration.allergicCarnivore: Allergic: entity types that set off a CARNIVORE. Entity ids, or #tags.
witchmod.configuration.allergicCleanEate: Allergic: entity types that set off a CLEAN EATER. Entity ids, or #tags.
witchmod.configuration.allergicItemsAreH: Allergic: forbidden items on the ground or in a nearby player's inventory count as hazardous mobs.
witchmod.configuration.allergicOwnInvent: Allergic: carrying a forbidden item in your OWN inventory counts as a hazard too.
witchmod.configuration.allergicCarnivore: Allergic: other players with the Vegetarian allergy count as hazards for a Carnivore.
witchmod.configuration.allergicCleanEate: Allergic: other players with a positive potion effect (not this mod's blessing markers) count as hazards for a Clean Eater.
witchmod.configuration.allergicMobTier1S: Allergic: a hazardous mob nearby causes tier 1 for this long (topped up while near).
witchmod.configuration.allergicMobTier2A: Allergic: seconds of mob exposure before the reaction becomes tier 2.
witchmod.configuration.allergicMobTier2S: Allergic: tier 2 from mob exposure lasts this long (topped up while near).
witchmod.configuration.allergicMobTier3A: Allergic: FURTHER seconds of mob exposure (on top of the tier 2 wait) before it becomes tier 3.
witchmod.configuration.allergicMobTier3S: Allergic: tier 3 from mob exposure lasts this long (topped up while near).
witchmod.configuration.allergicVegetaria: Allergic: vegetarians build mob exposure this much faster (1.25 = 25% faster).
witchmod.configuration.allergicExposureD: Allergic: how fast built-up exposure drains away once clear of every hazard, relative to how fast it builds (1.0 = the same rate, 2.0 = twice as fast).
witchmod.configuration.allergicTier1Atta: Allergic tier 1: attack cooldown is this percent longer.
witchmod.configuration.allergicTier2Atta: Allergic tier 2: attack cooldown is this percent longer.
witchmod.configuration.allergicTier3Atta: Allergic tier 3: attack cooldown is this percent longer.
witchmod.configuration.allergicTier1Hear: Allergic tier 1: hearts of max health lost (shown as green hearts). Always leaves at least 1 heart.
witchmod.configuration.allergicTier2Hear: Allergic tier 2: total hearts of max health lost.
witchmod.configuration.allergicTier3Hear: Allergic tier 3: total hearts of max health lost.
witchmod.configuration.allergicTier1FovR: Allergic tier 1: field of view narrowed by this fraction (0.05 = 5% narrower).
witchmod.configuration.allergicTier2FovR: Allergic tier 2: field of view narrowed by this fraction.
witchmod.configuration.allergicTier3FovR: Allergic tier 3: field of view narrowed by this fraction.
witchmod.configuration.backseatEpisodeSe: Backseat Driver: how long the AI keeps the wheel once it takes over.
witchmod.configuration.backseatEarlyExit: Backseat Driver: SHORTER cooldown used when the rider bailed out to end it early — escaping buys you less peace than sitting through it.
witchmod.configuration.backseatChanceGro: Backseat Driver: percentage points the takeover chance grows per second of riding.
witchmod.configuration.backseatChanceCap: Backseat Driver: normal ceiling the growing takeover chance is clamped to.
witchmod.configuration.backseatHazardCha: Backseat Driver: the ceiling is raised to THIS the moment a hazard (lava/water/a big drop) is spotted nearby — the AI is far more likely to grab the wheel near danger.
witchmod.configuration.backseatHazardSca: Backseat Driver: how far to look for hazards to steer into (and to raise the cap).
witchmod.configuration.backseatSpeedBoos: Backseat Driver: Speed effect level given to the hijacked mount for the episode, so it genuinely bolts under its own power (0 = no boost). The mount always uses its own movement — we never shove it with raw velocity, which is what made it slide/hover.
witchmod.configuration.backseatNavSpeedM: Backseat Driver: pathfinding speed multiplier for mounts that AREN'T rider-steered (e.g. a pig without a carrot on a stick) — those walk there via their own navigation.
witchmod.configuration.badSwimmerGravity: Bad Swimmer: gravity multiplier applied while in liquid. Vanilla divides gravity by 16 underwater (the slow bob), so ~16 restores air-like sinking. NOTE vanilla skips fluid gravity ENTIRELY while sprinting, so this half only bites when you AREN'T swimming; badSwimmerConstantPull is the half that always applies. 16.0 is the play-tested value. (The gravity attribute is also hard-capped at 1.0, i.e. a multiplier of ~12.)
witchmod.configuration.badSwimmerConstan: Bad Swimmer: constant downward pull (blocks/tick^2) while in liquid, applied client-side so it bites even while SWIMMING — this is what makes staying on the surface a battle instead of the curse simply switching off the moment you sprint-swim. Reference: a full swim-up tops out around 0.048, so values near that make ascending break even, and anything above it means you sink no matter how hard you swim.
witchmod.configuration.badSwimmerEntryPl: Bad Swimmer: one-shot downward yank the moment you break the surface, so entering water drags you under hard before the constant pull takes over.
witchmod.configuration.badSwimmerWaterEf: Bad Swimmer: water movement efficiency while in liquid. 1.0 makes water acceleration and friction match LAND exactly, i.e. you walk along the bottom instead of swimming.
witchmod.configuration.violenceCheckInte: Violence: how often (ticks) to roll for a forced swing. 20 = once a second.
witchmod.configuration.violenceSightCone: Violence: how far off-centre something can be and still count as 'looked directly at'. Sight-based swings also require line of sight, so you can't be set off through a wall.
witchmod.configuration.violenceSightChan: Violence: chance (%) per check of swinging at whatever you are looking straight at. These take INSTANT priority over impulsive urges and never ramp — staring at something in reach is simply dangerous, so keep your eyes off people.
witchmod.configuration.violenceSightHaza: Violence: chance (%) per check when the thing you are looking at would be shoved off a ledge or into lava. Looking at someone perched over a drop is close to a death sentence.
witchmod.configuration.violenceImpulsive: Violence: starting chance (%) per check of an impulsive swing — the camera-hijacking kind, aimed at something you are NOT looking at. Can happen at any time.
Violence: percentage points the impulsive chance grows per second since the last swing. Unlike the sight swings, these DO build up the longer you have gone without one.
Violence: ceiling the ramping impulsive chance is clamped to.
Violence: the ramp is overridden with THIS the moment something has been loitering at a ledge/hazard for violenceHazardSustainTicks — lingering next to a drop near a cursed player is asking for it.
witchmod.configuration.violenceHazardSus: Violence: how long (ticks) something must stay perched at a ledge/hazard before it massively boosts impulsive urges. 30 = 1.5 seconds.
witchmod.configuration.violenceLowHealth: Violence: at or below this % of max health, a target counts as wounded and climbs the priority order — though never above an environmental-hazard shove, which outranks it.
witchmod.configuration.violenceRandomTar: Violence: chance (%) that an impulsive urge throws the whole priority order out and just swings at someone at random — so it never becomes perfectly predictable.
witchmod.configuration.violenceTargetRan: Violence: how far away something can be and still get swung at.
witchmod.configuration.violencePlayerPri: Violence: how much more attractive a player is than a mob when picking a victim.
witchmod.configuration.violenceHazardBia: Violence: multiplier applied BOTH to a victim's pick weight and to the trigger chance when knocking them back would shove them off a ledge or into something nasty — so the curse both waits for those moments and aims at them.
witchmod.configuration.violenceHazardSho: Violence: how many blocks along the knockback direction to check for a hazard/ledge.
witchmod.configuration.violenceLedgeDrop: Violence: how many blocks of empty air below a spot make it count as a ledge worth shoving someone off.
witchmod.configuration.violenceMultiHitC: Violence: chance (%) that an urge becomes a full flurry instead of a single swing.
witchmod.configuration.violenceMultiHitM: Violence: fewest EXTRA swings in a flurry (on top of the first one).
Violence: most EXTRA swings in a flurry. Clamped to be >= violenceMultiHitMin at use.
witchmod.configuration.violenceMultiHitS: Violence: ticks between the swings of a flurry.
witchmod.configuration.violenceFullStren: Violence: force each stolen swing to land at FULL attack strength, so it hits as hard as a swing you timed yourself (and can sweep/crit) rather than for a fifth of the damage if you happened to be mid-cooldown. Independent of the cooldown refund below.
witchmod.configuration.violenceRefundsAt: Violence: whether a forced swing hands your attack cooldown back. FALSE (default) means a stolen swing costs you the cooldown exactly like a real one, so your own next hit is weakened — it takes something from you rather than being a free extra attack.
witchmod.configuration.butterfingersCool: Butterfingers: internal cooldown after ANY fumble. Shared by all three triggers, so a passive slip buys you the same grace as one caused by a hit — you can't be stripped.
witchmod.configuration.butterfingersPass: Butterfingers: how often (ticks) to roll the out-of-nowhere fumble.
Butterfingers: chance (%) per passive check of just dropping something for no reason. Deliberately rare — the point is that it mostly gets you at the worst moment instead.
witchmod.configuration.butterfingersOnDa: Butterfingers: chance (%) of fumbling when you take a hit — much likelier than passive.
witchmod.configuration.butterfingersOnSw: Butterfingers: chance (%) of fumbling when you swing a tool or weapon (mining or attacking) — the classic 'threw my pickaxe into the lava' moment.
witchmod.configuration.butterfingersDrop: Butterfingers: when your hands are empty, fumble a random hotbar item instead of doing nothing. False means empty hands are completely safe.
Butterfingers: drop the ENTIRE stack rather than a single item. True is far funnier and more punishing; the items are all still on the floor to be picked back up.
witchmod.configuration.explosivePower.to: Explosive: blast radius of the death explosion. TNT is 4.0, a creeper 3.0.
witchmod.configuration.explosiveCreatesF: Explosive: whether the blast leaves fires behind, like a charged creeper in the Nether.
witchmod.configuration.explosiveDelayTic: Explosive: ticks to wait after death before detonating. MUST be at least 1: the death event fires BEFORE vanilla drops your inventory, so an instant blast would go off while there is nothing to destroy. Waiting a tick lets the drops exist so they are caught in it.
Explosive: extra UPWARD launch given to anything caught in the death blast, on top of the explosion's own knockback — scaled down by distance. 0 disables the knockup.
witchmod.configuration.loadingScreenMinT: Loading Screen: shortest fake load, in ticks. 30 = 1.5 seconds.
witchmod.configuration.loadingScreenMaxT: Loading Screen: longest fake load, in ticks. 100 = 5 seconds.
witchmod.configuration.loadingScreenRest: Loading Screen: chance (%) that on reaching the end, the bar slides back down and loads all over again — the cruellest part of the joke.
witchmod.configuration.loadingScreenTipS: Loading Screen: how fast the tip marquee travels, in pixels per tick. 6.0 = 120px/sec, so a tip crosses a normal window in a few seconds — fast enough to actually read one during a short load. Lower it and you only ever catch a fragment.
witchmod.configuration.loadingScreenRest: Loading Screen: shortest extra load after a slide-back. 20 = 1 second.
Loading Screen: longest extra load after a slide-back. 60 = 3 seconds.
witchmod.configuration.loadingScreenStut: Loading Screen: chance (%) each second that the bar stutters — freezing in place as if the game has hung, without extending the progress itself. At 40 most loads will hitch at least once; loadingScreenMaxTotalTicks is what stops a bad run going on forever.
Loading Screen: shortest stutter freeze. 20 = 1 second.
Loading Screen: longest stutter freeze. 60 = 3 seconds.
witchmod.configuration.loadingScreenMaxT: Loading Screen: hard safety cap on one session, including every stutter and restart. Input is locked for the duration, so this guarantees you can never be stuck for longer than this no matter how the rolls land. 400 = 20 seconds.
witchmod.configuration.loadingScreenFram: Loading Screen: number of frames in the animation sprite sheet. The shipped chest sheet is 36 frames.
Loading Screen: width in pixels of ONE frame. Frames need not be square.
Loading Screen: height in pixels of ONE frame. The shipped chest sheet is 128x152.
witchmod.configuration.loadingScreenShee: Loading Screen: true if the sheet stacks frames DOWN one column (an Aseprite vertical export, like the shipped chest), false if they run left-to-right in one row.
witchmod.configuration.loadingScreenMusi: Loading Screen: relative weight of hold-music track 1. The four weights are rolled against their own total, so they need not add to anything in particular — the shipped 375/375/240/10 works out as 37.5% / 37.5% / 24% / 1%.
Loading Screen: relative weight of hold-music track 2.
Loading Screen: relative weight of hold-music track 3.
Loading Screen: relative weight of the rare goofy track. 10 of 1000 = 1%.
Loading Screen: volume of the normal hold-music tracks.
witchmod.configuration.loadingScreenGoof: Loading Screen: volume of the rare goofy track — deliberately quieter than the rest.
witchmod.configuration.loadingScreenFram: Loading Screen: ticks each animation frame is held. 2 = 10fps, so the 36-frame chest opens and shuts once every 3.6s — about the length of a typical fake load. 1 = 20fps.
witchmod.configuration.superExplosiveCha: Super Explosive: flat chance (%) of detonating each time you take damage. Deliberately constant — it never ramps, so it's a standing risk rather than a building one.
witchmod.configuration.superExplosivePow: Super Explosive: blast radius. TNT is 4.0, a creeper 3.0.
witchmod.configuration.superExplosiveSel: Super Explosive: percent of the blast's damage that you take yourself. You are at the dead centre of your own explosion, so at 100 it would simply one-shot you every time — 15 keeps it a genuine hit without being an execution. Everyone ELSE takes it in full.
witchmod.configuration.superExplosiveKno: Super Explosive: knockback multiplier for the blast, applied to everyone caught in it (you included). 1.0 is a vanilla explosion; higher sends people flying.
Pacing: shortest dramatic moment, in seconds.
Pacing: longest dramatic moment, in seconds.
witchmod.configuration.pacingLowBiasExpo: Pacing: how hard the random duration is biased toward the short end. The roll is min + (max-min) * r^exp with r in [0,1); 1.0 is uniform, higher favours shorter moments. 2.0 means most moments land near 5s with the occasional long one.
witchmod.configuration.pacingFreezeRadiu: Pacing: how far around the victim entities are caught in the time-stop.
witchmod.configuration.pacingMaxInvolved: Pacing: cap on how many nearby entities are frozen alongside the victim. This is a SAFETY limit, not a presentation one — every frozen entity is also made invulnerable and held in place each tick, so an uncapped sweep in a mob farm could hurt a server badly.
witchmod.configuration.pacingShotTicks.t: Pacing: ticks each camera angle is held before cutting to the next. 14 ~ 0.7s.
witchmod.configuration.pacingTheOnePiece: Pacing: 1-in-N chance that a camera-cut click is replaced by the revelation sound.
witchmod.configuration.pacingClickVolume: Pacing: volume of the click between camera cuts.
witchmod.configuration.pacingThemeVolume: Pacing: volume of the dramatic theme.
witchmod.configuration.popularitySpawnIn: Popularity: how often (ticks) to try conjuring hostiles around the victim. 45 ~ 2.25s; higher = the horde builds up more gradually.
witchmod.configuration.popularitySpawnAt: Popularity: spawn attempts per interval (not all find a valid spot). Lower = gentler ramp.
witchmod.configuration.popularityMaxMobs: Popularity: cap on curse-spawned mobs alive around the victim, so the horde is a crowd and not a lag machine. Spawning pauses once this many are already chasing.
witchmod.configuration.popularityDiscove: Popularity: discovered for the victim once this many curse-spawned mobs have amassed around them — you notice the mod when the crowd is unmistakable, not on the first spawn.
witchmod.configuration.popularityProlong: Popularity: how long (ticks) a hostile keeps hunting you AFTER losing line of sight before giving up — vanilla is ~60 (3s). 300 = 15s of dogged tracking through walls, but they still have to SEE you first to lock on (no straight-up x-ray vision).
witchmod.configuration.popularitySpawnRa: Popularity: nearest a conjured mob appears — kept off the victim so they don't pop in your face, they come running from a little way off.
Popularity: furthest a conjured mob appears.
witchmod.configuration.popularityMaxSpaw: Popularity: a conjured mob only appears where the light level is at or below this — the 'daylight and torches keep you safe' gate. 7 matches vanilla's dark-enough threshold, so lit areas and daytime surfaces stay clear while caves and night fill up.
witchmod.configuration.popularityDetecti: Popularity: any hostile within this radius locks onto the victim, walls or not — this is the 'detection radius is bigger' half, and it drags in natural spawns too, not just ours.
witchmod.configuration.popularityRetarge: Popularity: how often (ticks) nearby hostiles are set up as dedicated hunters (bigger follow range, prolonged tracking, doors) and, if they can SEE you, re-aimed at you so you stay the priority. 20 = 1s.
witchmod.configuration.yapIntervalMinTic: Yap: shortest gap between outbursts, in ticks. 200 = 10s.
witchmod.configuration.yapIntervalMaxTic: Yap: longest gap between outbursts, in ticks. 600 = 30s.
witchmod.configuration.yapSingleWeight.t: Yap: relative chance an outburst is a single message (most common).
witchmod.configuration.yapDoubleWeight.t: Yap: relative chance an outburst is a scripted 2-message combo, sent one after another.
witchmod.configuration.yapTripleWeight.t: Yap: relative chance an outburst is a scripted 3-message combo (rarest).
witchmod.configuration.yapMessageGapTick: Yap: ticks between the messages of a multi-message combo, so they land in sequence rather than all at once. 30 = 1.5s.
witchmod.configuration.yapEventCooldownT: Yap: cooldown (ticks) per EVENT reaction type — taking damage, dealing damage, opening a chest, dying, a player being near. Much longer than the ambient chatter so a reaction line stays a treat, not a spam. 2400 = 2 min, tracked separately per event.
witchmod.configuration.yapProximityRadiu: Yap: how close another player must be to set off the 'someone's near' reaction.
witchmod.configuration.yapStreamerChance: Yap+Chat synergy: percent chance an ambient outburst is a 'talking to chat' streamer line (from the yap.json events 'streamer' list) instead of a normal one.
witchmod.configuration.repelRadius.toolt: Repel: how close a dropped item or XP orb must be to the victim to start sliding away.
witchmod.configuration.repelSpeed.toolti: Repel: horizontal slide speed (blocks/tick). Kept below sprint (~0.13) so you can always chase your stuff down — 0.084 is a steady, catchable crawl.
witchmod.configuration.repelHazardScanRa: Repel: how far from each sliding item to look for a hazard (TNT/lava/cactus/ledge/player) to steer it toward — but only ever in a direction that still points AWAY from the victim.
witchmod.configuration.repelLedgeDropMin: Repel: blocks of empty air below a neighbouring column for it to count as a ledge worth nudging an item off.
Repel: cap on how many items/orbs are pushed per tick, so a giant pile can't lag.
witchmod.configuration.farmhandRadius.to: Farmhand: how far around the victim untamed animals get recruited to crowd them — a wide radius, so even fairly distant animals come waddling over to get in the way.
Farmhand: pathfinding speed multiplier for recruited animals — well above 1 so they visibly hustle to crowd you rather than ambling over.
witchmod.configuration.farmhandSpeedBonu: Farmhand: extra MOVEMENT_SPEED given to a hijacked animal as a fraction of its base (1.0 = double speed). A cow at base speed simply can't keep a player hemmed in; this is applied by the goal and handed straight back when the curse ends.
witchmod.configuration.farmhandSurroundR: Farmhand: how tight the ring of surrounding animals hugs the victim. Small = right in your face.
witchmod.configuration.farmhandRecruitIn: Farmhand: how often (ticks) nearby animals are (re)recruited and the crowd topped up.
witchmod.configuration.farmhandMinAnimal: Farmhand: if fewer than this many animals are nearby, conjure more (given valid spawn conditions) so you're never left in peace.
witchmod.configuration.farmhandSpawnCool: Farmhand: minimum ticks between top-up spawn bursts.
witchmod.configuration.farmhandSpawnAtte: Farmhand: spawn attempts per top-up burst (not all find valid animal-spawn conditions).
witchmod.configuration.farmhandSpawnRadi: Farmhand: nearest a conjured animal appears.
Farmhand: furthest a conjured animal appears.
witchmod.configuration.gluttonySprintCut: Gluttony: you stop sprinting at or below this on the COMBINED 40-point bar — double vanilla's threshold of 6, since the whole bar is doubled.
witchmod.configuration.gluttonyEatSpeedP: Gluttony: how much FASTER food is eaten, as a percent off the normal use time. 30 = a 30% shorter animation. The one perk of the curse — you have a lot of eating to do.
witchmod.configuration.gluttonySaturatio: Gluttony: percent of saturation taken back off every food eaten, so meals don't last and you have to keep grazing.
witchmod.configuration.gluttonyModelScal: Gluttony: added to the SCALE attribute, so 0.35 renders the player at 1.35x — physically wider, and it makes tight gaps a real problem.
witchmod.configuration.unhygienicMobFlee: Unhygienic: how far the stink reaches for NON-UNDEAD mobs — anything inside runs away. Undead are unbothered; they smell worse.
witchmod.configuration.unhygienicFleeSpe: Unhygienic: pathfinding speed multiplier for a mob fleeing the smell.
witchmod.configuration.unhygienicPanicRa: Unhygienic: get this close to a fleeing mob and it panics — it breaks into a proper run instead of an unhurried walk away.
witchmod.configuration.unhygienicPanicSp: Unhygienic: pathfinding speed multiplier while panicking (inside unhygienicPanicRadius).
witchmod.configuration.unhygienicPlayerD: Unhygienic: how close another PLAYER has to get before they start drifting away.
Unhygienic: how hard nearby players are nudged away per push. Deliberately subtle — a slide they can walk against, not a shove.
witchmod.configuration.unhygienicFlyInte: Unhygienic: ticks between fly specks. Spawning one every tick threw out ~80 particles a second and looked like flung dust; a slower rate along a smooth path reads as an actual fly and costs a fraction as much.
witchmod.configuration.unhygienicFlyVolu: Unhygienic: volume of the ambient fly buzz.
witchmod.configuration.unhygienicParticl: Unhygienic: ticks between puffs of the green stink cloud.
witchmod.configuration.unhygienicFlySoun: Unhygienic: shortest gap between ambient fly buzzes. 120 = 6s.
Unhygienic: longest gap between ambient fly buzzes. 400 = 20s.
witchmod.configuration.echoesIntervalMax: Echoes: longest gap between hallucinations. 1300 = 65s. The wide spread is the point — a predictable rhythm would tell the victim instantly which sounds were fake.
witchmod.configuration.echoesDiscoveryDe: Echoes: ticks after the FIRST hallucination before the victim is told what's happening, so the penny drops a moment later rather than the alert spoiling the sound. 40 = 2s.
witchmod.configuration.echoesVolume.tool: Echoes: master volume for hallucinated sounds. 1.0 keeps them indistinguishable from real ones, which is the whole point — turn it down only if they're overbearing.
witchmod.configuration.badSwimmerStepBon: Bad Swimmer: extra step height while in liquid, on top of vanilla's 0.6. 0.5 takes it to 1.1, so a single block can be WALKED up on the bottom. This is the lever rather than a weaker pull because underwater there is no impulse jump to boost — past the fluid-jump threshold vanilla routes jumping to a gentle sustained thrust, so the only way to clear a block by rising is to swim up, which is the one thing this curse exists to forbid.
witchmod.configuration.slipperyCheckInte: Slippery Feet: how often the standing-near-a-ledge roll is made, in ticks.
witchmod.configuration.slipperyStandingC: Slippery Feet: percent chance per check of slipping while merely STANDING near a ledge or hazard. Deliberately very low — standing near an edge should be a background dread, not a coin flip. The crouch case is where the curse actually bites.
witchmod.configuration.slipperyCrouchMin: Slippery Feet: shortest time crouched over a ledge before you are GUARANTEED to go off it. 20 = 1s.
witchmod.configuration.slipperyCrouchMax: Slippery Feet: longest that grace period lasts. 40 = 2s. The actual value is re-rolled between min and max each time you settle over an edge, so it can't be counted out.
witchmod.configuration.slipperyLedgeDrop: Slippery Feet: how many clear blocks below a neighbouring column make it a ledge.
witchmod.configuration.slipperyPushForce: Slippery Feet: how hard you are shoved off, in blocks/tick.
Slippery Feet: small upward kick on the shove, so you clear the lip of the block rather than scraping down its face.
witchmod.configuration.stickyBlocksDropp: Sticky: whether items refuse to be dropped (Q, and dragging out of the inventory).
witchmod.configuration.stickyBlocksArmou: Sticky: whether armour refuses to come off. Armour that BREAKS is still lost — the restore only fires when the piece can actually be found after removal, so this can't become an infinite-durability exploit.
witchmod.configuration.glassCannonDamage: Glass Cannon: multiplier on ALL incoming damage. 2.0 = you take 200%.
Glass Cannon: multiplier on MELEE damage you deal (direct hits only, not projectiles). 1.5 = you deal 150%.
witchmod.configuration.giantScale.toolti: Giant: SCALE multiplier (model AND hitbox). 3.0 = three times your size.
witchmod.configuration.giantSpeedMultipl: Giant: MOVEMENT_SPEED multiplier. 0.9 = 10% slower, a lumbering giant.
witchmod.configuration.giantAttackSpeedM: Giant: ATTACK_SPEED multiplier — a longer swing cooldown. 0.7 = a 30% slower swing.
witchmod.configuration.giantReachMultipl: Giant: ENTITY_INTERACTION_RANGE multiplier — the giant's reach. 2.0 = double, so it can hit things on the floor at its feet.
witchmod.configuration.giantDamageTakenM: Giant: multiplier on ALL incoming damage. 0.25 = you take 75% less.
witchmod.configuration.giantMeleeDealtMu: Giant: multiplier on MELEE damage you deal. 1.8 = you deal 80% more.
Giant: damage dealt to anything the giant physically stands on (before the melee multiplier).
witchmod.configuration.giantStompKnockba: Giant: how hard a stomped entity is launched clear (velocity units).
witchmod.configuration.giantStompInterva: Giant: minimum ticks between stomps on the SAME entity (they're launched clear, so this is a safety cap).
witchmod.configuration.giantHitKnockback: Giant: EXTRA knockback strength applied to a base melee hit (on top of vanilla's), so the giant's hits fling things.
Blessing of Speed: MOVEMENT_SPEED bonus applied ONLY while sprinting (its own modifier, stacks with Speed/Ninja). 0.6 = ~60% faster sprint.
witchmod.configuration.forgivenessHitbox: Forgiveness: how many blocks bigger (each side) an entity's hitbox is FOR YOU — melee near-misses connect and your projectiles curve onto it. ~0.4 ≈ 40% bigger on a typical mob; a flat floor helps tiny/baby mobs.
witchmod.configuration.forgivenessProjec: Forgiveness: how hard YOUR projectile curves onto an entity whose enlarged box it was about to pass through (0..1). Higher = it connects more reliably.
Forgiveness: how many ticks of travel ahead the projectile scans for an about-to-pass entity. Scaled by the shot's speed, so FAST arrows (≈3 blocks/tick) are actually caught, not just slow lobs.
witchmod.configuration.driveRadius.toolt: Drive: radius (blocks) within which nearby animals have their breeding cooldown cleared each tick.
witchmod.configuration.driveAutoBreedIdl: Drive: after this long without the blessed player breeding an animal themselves, nearby pairs start breeding on their own.
witchmod.configuration.driveAutoBreedInt: Drive: how often a spontaneous auto-breed is attempted (once the idle window has passed).
witchmod.configuration.driveAutoBreedCha: Drive: chance per attempt that a nearby same-type pair breeds with no food. With the Farmhand synergy the idle gate is ignored and babies join the nuisance.
witchmod.configuration.veinMinerMaxBlock: Vein Miner: max blocks felled in one break (the vein/tree cap, for safety/lag).
witchmod.configuration.collectorItemRadi: Collector: radius (blocks) within which dropped items are drawn to you.
witchmod.configuration.collectorItemSpee: Collector: pull speed (blocks/tick) for dropped items.
witchmod.configuration.collectorXpRadius: Collector: HUGE radius (blocks) within which XP orbs are dragged to you.
Collector: HUGE pull speed (blocks/tick) for XP orbs — the magnet on steroids.
witchmod.configuration.collectorGraceTic: Collector: how long (ticks) a dropped item must sit before it starts drifting to you — a grace period so fresh drops don't insta-float.
witchmod.configuration.collectorCrouchRa: Collector: while CROUCHING, the collection radius is multiplied by this (0.15 = greatly reduced, so you can crouch to grab specific drops).
witchmod.configuration.sanguineRegenMult: Sanguine: multiplier on your NATURAL regen. 0.2 = you heal at 20% of normal by resting.
witchmod.configuration.sanguineLifesteal: Sanguine: fraction of damage you deal (melee AND projectile) healed back to you. 0.3 = 30% lifesteal.
witchmod.configuration.homebodyRadius.to: Homebody: how near your spawn point (blocks) you must be to get the regen + haste comfort.
witchmod.configuration.homebodyRegenAmpl: Homebody: Regeneration amplifier granted near home (0 = Regen I).
witchmod.configuration.homebodyHasteAmpl: Homebody: Haste amplifier granted near home (0 = Haste I).
witchmod.configuration.sonarBuildupTicks: Sonar: the CHARGE/buildup (ticks) before a pulse fires — a telegraphed swell of sound + light. 50 = 2.5s.
witchmod.configuration.sonarRadius.toolt: Sonar: detection radius (blocks) of a ping.
witchmod.configuration.sonarGlowTicks.to: Sonar: how long (ticks) detected entities glow after a pulse. 50 = 2.5s.
witchmod.configuration.sonarCrouchRadius: Sonar: a CROUCHED player's effective detection radius multiplier (0.6 = 40% smaller, so crouching hides you better).
witchmod.configuration.sonarDamageReduct: Sonar: how many ticks are shaved off the next ping each time you take damage. 20 = 1s.
witchmod.configuration.heavyHandedDurabi: Heavy Handed: durability-loss multiplier on your tools and armour. 4.0 = they wear four times as fast. Applied as EXTRA damage on top of the normal loss, so Unbreaking still mitigates it — you're clumsy, not exempt from enchantments.
witchmod.configuration.trumpetVolume.too: Trumpet: loop volume. Doubles as the audible RANGE — with linear attenuation a mono sound carries roughly volume*16 blocks, so 1.0 ~ 16 blocks. (Needs a MONO ogg to position/attenuate at all — a stereo file plays globally at constant volume.)
witchmod.configuration.trumpetSprintPitc: Trumpet: playback pitch (= speed) while SPRINTING. 1.0 = normal; 1.15 is a slight, comedic speed-up. Clamped by the engine to [0.5, 2.0].
witchmod.configuration.trumpetWalkThresh: Trumpet: how much walk-animation speed counts as 'moving' before the music kicks in. Small enough to catch a walk, large enough to ignore idle jitter.
witchmod.configuration.fortuneExtraMin.t: Fortune: fewest EXTRA drops an ore can give. Additive on top of enchantment Fortune, not multiplicative — so it stacks but doesn't explode. Ore-tag blocks only.
Fortune: the MOST LIKELY number of extra drops — the peak of the distribution (a triangular roll between min and max). 1 = usually one bonus, occasionally more or none.
witchmod.configuration.fortuneExtraMax.t: Fortune: the most extra drops possible from one ore.
witchmod.configuration.windfallIntervalM: Windfall: shortest gap between items drifting by on the wind, in ticks. 340 = 17s.
Windfall: longest gap between drifts, in ticks. 3000 = 2.5min.
witchmod.configuration.windfallBeneficia: Windfall: chance (0..1) a drift is something GOOD rather than junk. 'Mostly beneficial'.
witchmod.configuration.windfallItemLifes: Windfall: ticks a drifted item survives before it is instantly removed if not grabbed. 300 = 15s.
witchmod.configuration.windfallWalkAwayD: Windfall: if you get further than this (blocks) from a drifting item, it is instantly removed.
witchmod.configuration.immortalityRecove: Immortality: recovery (rebuild) time for your FIRST death, in ticks. 160 = 8s.
Immortality: each further death ADDS this many ticks to the recovery. 200 = +10s (=> 8s, 18s, 28s).
witchmod.configuration.immortalityMaxUse: Immortality: how many deaths it saves you from before the blessing breaks. Default 3.
witchmod.configuration.immortalityShineS: Immortality: how often (ticks) a soft crystalline 'shine' chime plays while you rebuild — its pitch rises as you knit back together. 0 = silent rebuild.
witchmod.configuration.immortalityShineV: Immortality: volume of the rebuild shine chime.
witchmod.configuration.jesusDepthStrider: Jesus Depth Strider Speed Per Level
Jesus: while walking on the water SURFACE, Depth Strider on your boots instead speeds you up — this fractional MOVEMENT_SPEED bonus per Depth Strider level (0.2 = +20% per level, +60% at III).
witchmod.configuration.sixthSenseInterva: Sixth Sense: shortest gap between ordinary action-bar hints, in ticks. 600 = 30s.
Sixth Sense: longest gap between ordinary hints, in ticks. 1400 = 70s.
witchmod.configuration.sixthSenseRareCoo: Sixth Sense Rare Cooldown Min Ticks
Sixth Sense: shortest gap AFTER announcing a rare structure (they're higher-value), in ticks. 1800 = 90s.
Sixth Sense Rare Cooldown Max Ticks
Sixth Sense: longest gap after a rare-structure hint, in ticks. 3000 = 150s.
witchmod.configuration.sixthSenseRareRad: Sixth Sense: how far out (CHUNKS) to sense RARE structures (ancient city, end city, fortress...). 12 = 192 blocks.
witchmod.configuration.sixthSenseStructu: Sixth Sense: how far out (in CHUNKS) to sense ordinary structures. 8 chunks = 128 blocks.
witchmod.configuration.sixthSensePlayerR: Sixth Sense: how far out (blocks) to sense other players.
witchmod.configuration.sixthSenseBiomeRa: Sixth Sense: how far out (blocks) to sense a rare biome.
witchmod.configuration.ironStomachHunger: Iron Stomach: hunger gain from a BAD food is multiplied by this (the extra is added on top). 3.0 = +200%.
witchmod.configuration.ironStomachSatura: Iron Stomach: saturation gain from a BAD food is multiplied by this. 1.5 = +50%.
witchmod.configuration.ironStomachExtraS: Iron Stomach: saturation modifier for the EXTRA edibles (glistering melon, sugar, cane, etc.) — the granted saturation is their hunger value times this. 0.1 = light, doesn't stick long.
witchmod.configuration.ironStomachMelonR: Iron Stomach: seconds of Regeneration a glistering melon slice grants when eaten. 3 seconds.
Iron Stomach: Regeneration level a glistering melon slice grants (5 = Regeneration V).
witchmod.configuration.dexterousSpreadRe: Dexterous: fraction of a shot's NATURAL spread to keep (0 = dead on the crosshair, 1 = vanilla). Compresses each shot toward your aim: single shots become very accurate, and multishot's ±10° fan is squeezed to a tight-but-visible spread that can still all hit one target. 0.2 = keep 20%.
witchmod.configuration.dexterousChargeSp: Dexterous: extra charge ticks credited each use tick while drawing a bow/loading a crossbow. 1 = roughly double charge speed.
witchmod.configuration.dexterousShieldDe: Dexterous: ticks a shield takes to raise into a block (vanilla is 5). Lower = faster guard.
witchmod.configuration.hawkGuyHomingStre: Hawk Guy: how hard your projectiles bend toward the marked target each tick while airborne (0..1) at CLOSE range (<= hawkGuyHomingNearDistance). 0.3 is a strong, obvious homing arc up close.

Hawk Guy: homing strength at/beyond hawkGuyHomingFarDistance — much more blatant, so a long-range shot curves hard onto the target even when it left your bow well off-line. Lerped from the close value.
witchmod.configuration.hawkGuyHomingNear: Hawk Guy: at/under this distance (blocks) from the target the CLOSE strength applies (kept gentle).
witchmod.configuration.hawkGuyHomingFarD: Hawk Guy: at/over this distance (blocks) the FAR strength applies; between the two it lerps.
witchmod.configuration.hawkGuyAcquireCon: Hawk Guy: half-angle (degrees) of the cone around your aim used to pick the intended target on release. Deliberately wide/forgiving so a target well off the crosshair is still grabbed and homed onto.
witchmod.configuration.hawkGuyAcquireRan: Hawk Guy: how far (blocks) the acquisition raycast/cone looks for the intended target. Generous so distant targets get locked (the far-range homing then curves the shot in).
witchmod.configuration.hawkGuyMaxHomingR: Hawk Guy: if the projectile ends up further than this (blocks) from its target, it stops homing.
witchmod.configuration.trainerVillagerXp: Personal Trainer: multiplier on the XP a villager gains from YOUR trades. Cranked high for now so the level-up is blatant/visible (villager XP is otherwise invisible); tune back toward ~3x for release balance.
witchmod.configuration.trainerNearbyRadi: Personal Trainer: radius (blocks) around a trade in which OTHER villagers also get coached.
witchmod.configuration.trainerLevelUpDel: Personal Trainer: ticks before a coached villager levels up (vanilla is 40). Small = near-instant.
witchmod.configuration.studiousXpMultipl: Studious: multiplier on all XP you take in. 2.5 = 2.5x.
witchmod.configuration.twistNegateChance: Twist of Fate: BASE chance (0..1) an incoming hit is negated (when off cooldown). 0.12 = 12%.
witchmod.configuration.twistCooldownTick: Twist of Fate: brief cooldown after a dodge before it can trigger again, in ticks. 60 = 3s.
witchmod.configuration.twistPityIncremen: Twist of Fate: how much the dodge chance climbs per hit that DIDN'T dodge (bad-luck protection); resets to 0 on a successful dodge.
witchmod.configuration.twistMaxChance.to: Twist of Fate: ceiling the base+pity dodge chance can reach.
Twist of Fate: brief invulnerability granted right after a dodge, in ticks. 15 = 0.75s.
witchmod.configuration.mainCharRadius.to: Main Character: radius (blocks) it counts nearby hostiles / players in to decide if you're 'surrounded'.
witchmod.configuration.mainCharHostileTh: Main Character: hostile mobs nearby to activate (tier 1). Tier 2 is DOUBLE this.
witchmod.configuration.mainCharPlayerThr: Main Character: nearby players to activate (tier 1). Tier 2 is DOUBLE this.
witchmod.configuration.mainCharStickyTic: Main Character: how long the buffs + music linger after you stop meeting the conditions, in ticks. 80 = 4s.
witchmod.configuration.mainCharCooldownR: Main Character: attack-cooldown reduction at tier 1 (0..1). 0.30 = 30% faster attacks.
Main Character: attack-cooldown reduction at tier 2 (0..1). 0.45 = 45% faster attacks.
witchmod.configuration.mainCharKnockback: Main Character: outgoing-knockback multiplier at tier 1. 1.3 = 1.3x.
Main Character: outgoing-knockback multiplier at tier 2. 1.6 = 1.6x.
witchmod.configuration.mainCharHordeThre: Main Character: hostiles aggroed onto you to reach the HORDE tier (3) — a swarm this size grants big buffs (Strength, Resistance II, Regeneration). Works with any horde source, not just Popularity.
witchmod.configuration.mainCharCooldownR: Main Character: attack-cooldown reduction at the HORDE tier (0..1). 0.6 = 60% faster attacks.
witchmod.configuration.mainCharKnockback: Main Character: outgoing-knockback multiplier at the HORDE tier. 2.0 = 2x.
witchmod.configuration.mainCharMusicVolu: Main Character: volume of the battle-theme loop at the protagonist (fades with distance for onlookers).
witchmod.configuration.mainCharMusicRang: Main Character: how far (blocks) nearby players can hear the theme; volume fades to 0 at this range. (Manual falloff, because the supplied stereo track can't be positionally attenuated by the engine.)
witchmod.configuration.farmersSpiritRadi: Farmer's Spirit: radius (blocks) of the CIRCLE around you that plants grow fast in.
witchmod.configuration.farmersSpiritInte: Farmer's Spirit: ticks between growth passes. Higher = crops climb their stages a touch slower.
witchmod.configuration.farmersSpiritAtte: Farmer's Spirit: how many random nearby spots are 'bone-mealed' each pass (covers the circle).
witchmod.configuration.farmersSpiritProd: Farmer's Spirit: extra random-ticks applied per hit to fruit/stalk PRODUCERS (pumpkin/melon stems, sugar cane, cactus, bamboo) so they crank out blocks fast enough to farm effectively.
witchmod.configuration.farmersSpiritGrow: Farmer's Spirit: bone-meal applications a crop gets per hit. 1 = climb ONE stage at a time (quick, but you can watch it grow rather than instant).
witchmod.configuration.farmersSpiritGras: Farmer's Spirit: chance (0..1) a grass BLOCK is bone-mealed when picked — kept low, so grass spreads flowers/tall grass only 'to a lesser extent' than crops/saplings shoot up.
witchmod.configuration.farmersSpiritBaby: Farmer's Spirit: age-ticks shaved off every nearby BABY animal each pass, so young livestock grow up quicker.
witchmod.configuration.farmersSpiritDriv: Farmer's Spirit+Drive synergy: baby-growth speed is multiplied by this while Drive is also active.
witchmod.configuration.bruteRampTimeTick: Brute: ticks of consistent sprinting (no jumping/interruptions) to reach top speed. 30 = 1.5s.
witchmod.configuration.bruteMaxSpeedMult: Brute: movement-speed multiplier at full charge. 2.6 = 2.6x.
witchmod.configuration.bruteSprintGraceT: Brute: how long the charge survives a brief sprint drop (a wall collision cancels vanilla sprint, a jump/turn can too) before it resets. Keeps the build-up fluid.
Brute: an initial quiet windup (no particles, no speed) of consistent sprinting before the ramp. 15 = 0.75s. Once completed it is BANKED — a jump resets only the ramp, not this windup.
witchmod.configuration.bruteShakeTicks.t: Brute: how long the little camera jolt lasts when you smash a block, in ticks.
witchmod.configuration.bruteShakeStrengt: Brute: strength of that smash camera jolt (slight).
witchmod.configuration.bruteFootstepVolu: Brute: volume of the amplified footsteps while you wind up and sprint (vanilla steps are ~0.15).
witchmod.configuration.bruteEntityHitCoo: Brute: per-entity cooldown (ticks) between plough-hits, so you cleave through a crowd hitting each once rather than the same body every tick. You keep full charge (no momentum bleed).
witchmod.configuration.bruteCapThreshold: Brute: charge fraction (0..1) at which you start launching entities and smashing blocks.
Brute: how hard entities you plough into are launched, at full charge.
witchmod.configuration.bruteSmashPower.t: Brute: explosion power when you ram a wall at full charge — blasts a hole so you run through. Respects blast resistance (obsidian/bedrock stop you) and mobGriefing. 0 = no smashing.
Brute: health spent per wall-smash explosion (won't smash if it would drop you too low).
witchmod.configuration.bruteLaunchDamage: Brute: damage dealt to entities you plough into.
witchmod.configuration.bruteSpeedChargeB: Brute+Speed synergy: extra charge ticks banked per tick while a speed blessing is on you (1 = charges twice as fast).
witchmod.configuration.bruteSpeedKnockba: Brute+Speed synergy: entities you plough into are flung this much harder.
witchmod.configuration.bruteSpeedBonusDa: Brute+Speed synergy: extra flat damage on a plough hit.
witchmod.configuration.chatIntervalMinTi: Chat: shortest gap between chat messages, in ticks, at peak hype (chat floods when you pop off).
witchmod.configuration.chatIntervalMaxTi: Chat: longest gap between chat messages, in ticks, when the chat is basically dead.
Chat: chance (0..1) a given message is a genuinely-useful info drop (nearby structure/player/etc).
witchmod.configuration.chatScoreMax.tool: Chat: cap on the internal entertainment score. Large = a real grind to fill (harder to climb).
witchmod.configuration.chatDeadThreshold: Chat: hype fraction (0..1) at/below which the chat goes DEAD — sparse, sad, no subs. Crawl out of it.
witchmod.configuration.chatReviveThresho: Chat: hype fraction (0..1) you must EXCEED to revive a dead chat (hysteresis, so it doesn't flicker).
witchmod.configuration.chatPvpScore.tool: Chat: entertainment score gained for a PvP hit (HIGH).
witchmod.configuration.chatPveScore.tool: Chat: entertainment score gained for a PvE hit (small — it's the kill that matters).
witchmod.configuration.chatBuildScore.to: Chat: entertainment score gained for placing a block (small).
witchmod.configuration.chatMineScore.too: Chat: entertainment score gained for breaking a block (small).
witchmod.configuration.chatIdleDecay.too: Chat: score lost per tick while IDLING (standing still doing nothing) — bleeds fast, keep performing.
Chat: score lost per tick while doing nothing entertaining (moving about but not performing).
witchmod.configuration.chatSubsCap.toolt: Chat: maximum subs you can bank in one stream (caps the end reward). Big ceiling for big streams.
witchmod.configuration.chatSubsPerEmeral: Chat: subs required per EMERALD paid out at stream's end. Emeralds are the ONLY reward. Higher = stingier.
witchmod.configuration.chatSleepDecay.to: Chat: entertainment score lost per tick while you're SLEEPING (nobody tunes in to watch you nap) — a slight drain.
witchmod.configuration.chatSubPerViewerT: Chat: subs gained per VIEWER per tick. Since viewers scale exponentially with hype, subs explode at the top and barely move at the bottom.
witchmod.configuration.chatStructureRadi: Chat: how far out (chunks) the useful-info drops look for structures.
witchmod.configuration.chatKillScore.too: Chat: score for killing a mob (a real highlight — spikes the chat).
Chat: score for killing a PLAYER — the single most entertaining thing you can do.
witchmod.configuration.chatCritScore.too: Chat: bonus score for landing a critical hit.
witchmod.configuration.chatDamageScore.t: Chat: score for taking a big hit (drama is entertaining). Applies at/above the damage threshold.
witchmod.configuration.chatDamageThresho: Chat: minimum damage (half-hearts) taken in one hit to count as a 'big hit' for chat.
witchmod.configuration.chatClutchScore.t: Chat: score for surviving a hit that leaves you on very low HP (a clutch — chat goes wild).
witchmod.configuration.chatClutchHp.tool: Chat: HP (half-hearts) at or below which surviving a hit counts as a clutch.
witchmod.configuration.chatDeathPenaltyF: Chat: fraction (0..1) of your current entertainment score WIPED when you die — dying tanks interest.
witchmod.configuration.chatDeathSpamTick: Chat: how long (ticks) chat rapidly spams dealwithit/trolldance gifs after you die.
witchmod.configuration.chatFallScore.too: Chat: score for taking notable fall damage (a classic fail).
witchmod.configuration.chatFallThreshold: Chat: minimum fall distance (blocks) to be worth a fail reaction.
witchmod.configuration.chatOreScore.tool: Chat: score for mining a valuable ore (diamonds/emeralds/ancient debris).
witchmod.configuration.chatFishScore.too: Chat: score for reeling in a catch.
witchmod.configuration.chatTameScore.too: Chat: score for taming an animal (chat loves a new pet).
witchmod.configuration.chatTradeScore.to: Chat: score for a villager trade.
witchmod.configuration.chatEatScore.tool: Chat: score for eating (small — mukbang content).
Chat: score for entering a fresh chunk (exploring keeps the stream moving).
witchmod.configuration.chatComboWindowTi: Chat: window (ticks) within which chained highlights build the hype train / combo multiplier.
witchmod.configuration.chatComboMaxMulti: Chat: maximum score multiplier from a hot combo streak.
witchmod.configuration.chatHypeTrainHits: Chat: number of chained highlights that triggers a HYPE TRAIN (big sub surge + banner).
witchmod.configuration.chatHypeTrainSubB: Chat: instant sub bonus awarded when a hype train launches.
witchmod.configuration.chatDonationChanc: Chat: per-message chance (0..1), scaled by hype, of a random bit donation event (bonus subs).
witchmod.configuration.chatRaidChance.to: Chat: per-message chance (0..1), scaled by hype, of a random incoming raid (viewer + sub surge).
witchmod.configuration.chatViewerBase.to: Chat: viewer count at ZERO hype — keep it tiny (near-dead) so climbing means something.
witchmod.configuration.chatViewerMax.too: Chat: viewer count at FULL hype. Viewers scale EXPONENTIALLY base->max, so the top end blows up (a lot higher) while the bottom crawls.
witchmod.configuration.chatHypeEase.tool: Chat: how fast the shown hype eases toward the real score each tick (0..1). Smaller = more gradual climbs/drops (not instant).
witchmod.configuration.chatEmoteChance.t: Chat: chance (0..1) a normal chat line is a spammed EMOTE image instead of text, at full hype (scales down with hype).
witchmod.configuration.chatGifChance.too: Chat: chance (0..1) a normal chat line is an animated GIF instead, at full hype (scales down with hype). Kept rarer than emotes.
witchmod.configuration.laughTrackCooldow: Laugh Track: minimum ticks between reactions, so rapid-fire chat doesn't stack the crowd. 120 = 6s.
witchmod.configuration.laughTrackCheerCh: Laugh Track: chance (0..1) the reaction is a CHEER rather than a laugh. 0.1 = 10% cheers, 90% laughs.
Laugh Track: volume of the crowd reaction played to everyone.
witchmod.configuration.coyoteTicks.toolt: Coyote: how many ticks after walking off a ledge you can still jump (coyote time). 6 = 0.3s.
witchmod.configuration.coyoteEdgeMagneti: Coyote: gentle per-tick nudge (blocks/tick) toward a ledge you're falling short of, capped so it assists rather than accelerates you.
witchmod.configuration.coyoteAssistMaxSp: Coyote: the edge assist only helps you up to THIS horizontal speed (blocks/tick) and never faster — so it nudges slow/short jumps onto ledges but never turns a sprint jump into a rocket. ~0.26 = below a sprint jump.
witchmod.configuration.anglerBiteExtraTi: Angler: extra ticks knocked off the bite timer each tick (on top of vanilla's 1). 5 = fish bite ~6x faster.
witchmod.configuration.anglerMultiChance: Angler: chance (0..1) a catch pulls out MULTIPLE things (an extra copy of the loot).
witchmod.configuration.anglerSurpriseCha: Angler: chance (0..1) a catch also drags a comical surprise out of the water (treasure/fish/mob/TNT).
witchmod.configuration.excavationRampPer: Excavation: extra mining-speed bonus gained per block broken. 0.15 = +15%/block (~40 to cap).
witchmod.configuration.excavationMaxBonu: Excavation: cap on the mining-speed bonus. 6.0 = up to 7x mining speed.
witchmod.configuration.excavationDecayGr: Excavation: ticks after your last break before the built-up speed decays (covers mining one slow block). 20 = 1s.
witchmod.configuration.excavationDecayPe: Excavation: bonus lost per tick once the grace lapses. 0.06 fades a full 6.0 stack to 0 over ~5s.
witchmod.configuration.bouncyRestitution: Bouncy: how elastic your landing rebounds are (0..1). Lower settles in a few bounces; holding jump adds on top, so you still build height. 0.65 bounces like a slime block that eventually stops.
witchmod.configuration.bouncyJumpBonus.t: Bouncy (now a CURSE): JUMP_STRENGTH bonus as a fraction (0.5 = +50% jump height) — springy legs launch you higher.
Bouncy: cap on rebound velocity, so it can't runaway into orbit.
witchmod.configuration.bouncyMinFallVelo: Bouncy: minimum impact speed (blocks/tick) to rebound when you're NOT holding jump — so only real falls from height bounce and normal jumping/landing doesn't spam little bounces. 0.5 ~ a 1.5-block drop. Holding jump drops the threshold so you can trampoline and build height. Sneak = never bounce.
witchmod.configuration.bouncyEntityForce: Bouncy: how hard entities are flung when you SPRINT into them / they sprint into you / they hit you.
witchmod.configuration.bouncyWalkForceMu: Bouncy: fraction of the entity force applied when you merely WALK into something (a slight nudge).
witchmod.configuration.bouncyCollisionSp: Bouncy: how fast an entity must be closing on you (blocks/tick) to bounce off when YOU are still.
witchmod.configuration.bouncyWallMinSpee: Bouncy: horizontal speed (blocks/tick) needed to rebound off a wall. Must sit below sprint speed (~0.13) or you can never wall-bounce while running — the old hardcoded 0.15 was above it, so wall bounces never fired.
witchmod.configuration.bouncyLowGravRest: Bouncy+Low Gravity synergy: floor/wall/ceiling rebounds are this much stronger (and the landing cap is lifted the same).
witchmod.configuration.hotStuffSpeedMult: Hot Stuff: how many times faster a furnace cooks while you're looking at it. 10.0 = 10x.
witchmod.configuration.hotStuffScorchedM: Hot Stuff+Floor is Lava synergy: the furnace speed multiplier is scaled by this again (2.0 = double).
witchmod.configuration.pickpocketUnseenM: Pickpocket+Unseen synergy: pickpocket chance multiplier when behind someone while unseen.
witchmod.configuration.pickpocketDisguis: Pickpocket+Disguise/Prop Hunt synergy: pickpocket chance multiplier when behind someone while wearing a form.
witchmod.configuration.pickpocketSnackCh: Pickpocket+Munchies/Gluttony synergy (snack thief): chance (0..1) per attempt to steal and instantly eat one of a nearby player's foods when your hunger is nearly full. Rolled independently of the normal pickpocket lift. The chance slides toward pickpocketSnackChanceStarving as your hunger empties.
Snack thief: chance (0..1) per attempt when your hunger bar is empty.
witchmod.configuration.pickpocketSnackIn: Snack thief: ticks between snack attempts when your hunger is nearly full (60 = every 3s). Slides toward pickpocketSnackIntervalStarvingTicks as your hunger empties.
Snack thief: ticks between snack attempts when your hunger bar is empty (10 = every 0.5s).
witchmod.configuration.silverVillagerRef: Silver Tongue+Disguise synergy: percent chance a completed villager trade refunds its cost.
witchmod.configuration.homecomingRegenSe: Homebody+Safety synergy: seconds of Regeneration granted after a teleport home.
witchmod.configuration.homecomingRegenAm: Homebody+Safety synergy: Regeneration amplifier after a teleport (9 = Regeneration 10).
witchmod.configuration.allergicGassyTier: Allergic+Gassy synergy: percent chance PER SECOND of a reaction fart at tier 1.
Allergic+Gassy synergy: percent chance per second of a reaction fart at tier 2.
Allergic+Gassy synergy: percent chance per second of a reaction fart at tier 3.
Allergic Gassy Tier3 Big Chance Percent
Allergic+Gassy synergy: percent of tier 3 reaction farts that are BIG ones.
witchmod.configuration.allergicHiccupsTi: Allergic+Hiccups synergy: percent chance PER SECOND of a reaction hiccup at tier 1.
Allergic+Hiccups synergy: percent chance per second of a reaction hiccup at tier 2.
Allergic+Hiccups synergy: percent chance per second of a reaction hiccup at tier 3.
witchmod.configuration.layeredHideFloorB: Thick Skinned+Tank synergy: extra damage added to the negation floor (1.0 = threshold +1).
witchmod.configuration.violenceFrenzyCha: Violence+Berserker (frenzy) synergy: the impulsive swing chance AND its cap are scaled by this.
witchmod.configuration.deadWeightPullMul: Dense+Bad Swimmer synergy: the client sink pull is scaled by this — you drop like a stone.
witchmod.configuration.dizzyHeightsStart: Wonky+Vertigo synergy: vertigo's onset height is scaled by this (0.8 = 20% lower).
witchmod.configuration.dizzyHeightsSwayM: Wonky+Vertigo synergy: vertigo's camera + movement sway is scaled by this.
witchmod.configuration.speedDemonIceBonu: Speed Demon+Ice Skates (greased_mount) synergy: extra stacking mount-speed bonus (0.5 = +50%).
witchmod.configuration.sizeCrisisMinGapT: Giant+Dwarfism (size_crisis) synergy: shortest gap (ticks) before the size flips.
witchmod.configuration.sizeCrisisMaxGapT: Giant+Dwarfism (size_crisis) synergy: longest gap (ticks) before the size flips.
witchmod.configuration.sizeCrisisCrushDa: Giant+Dwarfism (size_crisis) synergy: crush damage dealt to a mount you shrink on top of.
witchmod.configuration.sizeCrisisSmallRe: Giant+Dwarfism (size_crisis) synergy: while SMALL, the kept giant reach bonus is scaled by this (0.5 = extra reach halved).
witchmod.configuration.hotStuffLookRange: Hot Stuff: how far (blocks) your gaze reaches to heat up a furnace.
witchmod.configuration.silverTongueDisco: Silver Tongue: how much cheaper villager trades are (0..1). 0.75 = pay 25%, get 75% refunded.
witchmod.configuration.unseenRevealDista: Unseen: how close (blocks) someone must be to see you at all — beyond it you're fully hidden, and mobs can't lock onto you. Getting within it is the obvious counterplay. ~6 blocks.
witchmod.configuration.thickSkinnedDamag: Thick Skinned: any single damage event AT OR BELOW this is fully ignored; damage must exceed it to land. 2.0 = 1 heart.
witchmod.configuration.thickSkinnedShake: Thick Skinned: how long the little feedback screenshake lasts when a hit is shrugged off, in ticks.
Thick Skinned: strength of that feedback screenshake (subtle).
witchmod.configuration.lastStandReviveHe: Last Stand: health you're left on after a fatal blow. 1.0 = half a heart.
witchmod.configuration.lastStandInvulnTi: Last Stand: complete invulnerability granted right after a revive — a comeback window. 40 = 2s.
Last Stand: how many times it can revive you before the blessing is consumed.
witchmod.configuration.lastStandBaseCool: Last Stand: cooldown after the FIRST revive, in ticks (doubles each subsequent revive). 6000 = 5min.
witchmod.configuration.lastStandKnockbac: Last Stand: outward knockback strength applied to nearby entities on the burst (no damage).
witchmod.configuration.lastStandRadius.t: Last Stand: radius (blocks) of the knockback burst.
witchmod.configuration.cornucopiaSlots.t: Cornucopia: how many random blessings it holds on you at once, ON TOP of the normal blessing limit.
witchmod.configuration.cornucopiaSwapSec: Cornucopia: seconds between swaps — each swap trades the OLDEST held blessing for a new random one.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerCooldown: Puppeteer: seconds after leaving (or losing) a puppet before you can possess another. (1 while testing — raise it for real play, e.g. 60.)
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerPossessT: Puppeteer: length (ticks) of the possession itself — the mob freezes, your soul streams into it and your body is drawn into its spot before you take control.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerReleaseG: Puppeteer: when you step out, the mob stands dazed (no AI) for this many ticks so it doesn't instantly attack you. Saved with the mob, so a crash or unload can never leave it stuck that way.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerMonsters: Puppeteer: while you're possessing something, monsters don't target you (you're one of them, or prey they'd ignore anyway).
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerZombieSp: Puppeteer (zombies): your movement speed as a multiple of normal (sprinting still works).
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerZombieAt: Puppeteer (zombies): damage of each hit (before your own blessings/curses scale it).
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerZombieRe: Puppeteer (zombies): how far you can hit (blocks) — a zombie's short reach, not a player's 3.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerZombieRa: Puppeteer (zombies): Rally MARKS whoever you're LOOKING AT, up to this many blocks away.

Puppeteer (zombies): the marked target glows, and every zombie variant within this many blocks of you goes after it with a speed boost. (Skeleton puppets use the same radius: skeletons near you shoot at whatever your arrows hit.)
Puppeteer (zombies): how long the mark (glowing) and the rallied zombies' speed boost last.

Puppeteer (zombies): if a Rally finds NO zombies nearby and the light where you stand is at or below this level (0-15), 1-2 of YOUR kind (zombies, husks, ...) claw their way up nearby to answer the call.
Puppeteer (zombies): the most a dark Rally can summon (it rolls 1..this).
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerZombieBu: Puppeteer (zombie, zombie villager, drowned): burn in direct daylight without a helmet, like the real thing (the puppet takes it). Husks and zombified piglins never burn.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerHuskHung: Puppeteer (husk): each hit gives the victim Hunger for this long, like a real husk.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerDrownedS: Puppeteer (drowned): extra swim speed in water (1.0 = double), and you never run out of air.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerDrownedT: Puppeteer (drowned): ticks between trident throws. Hold right-click to charge (like a real trident, at least 10 ticks), let go to throw. Anything it hits is marked for nearby drowned — and if none are around and it's dark or near water, 1-2 drowned rise to answer (the Rally knobs above apply).
Puppeteer (drowned): thrown tridents can't be picked up and vanish after this many ticks.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerCreeperS: Puppeteer (creeper): your movement speed as a multiple of normal (sprinting still works).
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerCreeperA: Puppeteer (creeper): damage of each hit — creepers aren't fighters, it's a shove.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerCreeperR: Puppeteer (creeper): how far you can hit (blocks).
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerCreeperF: Puppeteer (creeper): hold right-click this long (ticks) to explode (a real creeper's is 30). Letting go winds the fuse back down.
Puppeteer (creeper): how much slower you move while the fuse is lit (0.75 = 75% slower).
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerAnimalSp: Puppeteer (farm animals): your movement speed as a multiple of normal (sprinting still works).
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerAnimalAt: Puppeteer (farm animals): damage of each hit — a headbutt, not a weapon.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerAnimalRe: Puppeteer (farm animals): how far you can hit (blocks).
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerAnimalSo: Puppeteer (pig / cow / sheep): ticks between Oinks, Moos and grazes.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerAnimalLu: Puppeteer (farm animals): another player holding your animal's food (wheat, carrots, seeds...) within this many blocks drags you towards them, like Siren's Call. 0 = off.
Puppeteer (farm animals): how hard that food drags you (added speed per tick).
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerChickenE: Puppeteer (chicken): ticks between LAID eggs (tap right-click). 500 = 25s. Chickens also fall gently.
Puppeteer (chicken): ticks between EXPLOSIVE eggs — HOLD right-click to charge (like a bow, at least 10 ticks) and let go to throw. Its own cooldown, separate from laying. 160 = 8s.
Puppeteer (chicken): throw speed of a fully charged explosive egg (scaled by charge like a bow).
Puppeteer (chicken): explosion power of the explosive egg (tnt is 4). Respects mobGriefing.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerSkeleton: Puppeteer (skeleton): your movement speed as a multiple of normal (sprinting still works).
Puppeteer (skeleton): damage of a melee hit (your arrows are a real bow's).
Puppeteer (skeleton): how far you can hit in melee (blocks).
Puppeteer (skeleton): you draw a REAL bow (arrows and archery blessings work as normal) this much faster than a player (1.25 = 25% faster). Stacks with draw-speed blessings like Dexterous.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerSpiderSp: Puppeteer (spiders): your movement speed as a multiple of normal. You climb walls like the Spider blessing (hold forward against a wall), and every swing POUNCES you forward like a real spider's attack.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerSpiderRe: Puppeteer (spiders): how far you can bite (blocks).
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerSpiderPo: Puppeteer (spiders): how far a swing's pounce throws you forward (a vanilla spider's leap is 0.4).
Puppeteer (spiders): ticks between pounces (you have to be on the ground, too).
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerCaveSpid: Puppeteer (cave spider): bites poison the victim for this long, like a real cave spider's.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerSpiderAi: Puppeteer (spiders): swinging MID-JUMP pounces again (once per jump) — this much harder forward than a ground pounce, for travel.
Puppeteer (spiders): and a little extra lift on the air pounce.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerWitherSk: Puppeteer (wither skeleton): damage of each hit (no special move — it hasn't one in vanilla either).
Puppeteer (wither skeleton): hits inflict Wither for this long (vanilla: 10). It's fire immune and never burns in daylight.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerGuardian: Puppeteer Guardian Swim Bonus
Puppeteer (guardians): extra swim speed in water (1.0 = double). Endless air.
Puppeteer Guardian Land Slow
Puppeteer (guardians): out of water you flop and bounce about like a beached guardian (it doesn't dry out, it's just awkward) — this much slower (0.5 = half speed).
Puppeteer Guardian Flop Power
Puppeteer (guardians): how high each beached bounce goes.
Puppeteer Guardian Beam Range
Puppeteer (guardians): the laser's reach (blocks). HOLD right-click to fire a beam you aim yourself; it ticks damage on whatever it's on and ends in a burst.
Puppeteer Guardian Beam Ticks
Puppeteer (guardians): full beam length (ticks). Holding this long fires the full BURST automatically.
Puppeteer Guardian Beam Min Burst Ticks
Puppeteer (guardians): let go after at least this many ticks and you still get a (weaker) burst, scaled by how long you held. Let go sooner and the beam just fizzles out.
Puppeteer Guardian Beam Tick Damage
Puppeteer (guardians): damage the beam does to what it's on, every 10 ticks (magic — ignores armour).
Puppeteer Guardian Burst Damage
Puppeteer (guardian): damage of the full burst (a real guardian's beam does 6).
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerElderGua: Puppeteer (elder guardian): damage of the full burst — an elder's beam is a real threat.
Puppeteer Elder Guardian Beam Tick Damage
Puppeteer (elder guardian): the beam's damage every 10 ticks while it's on something.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerGuardian: Puppeteer Guardian Beam Cooldown Ticks
Puppeteer (guardians): ticks after a burst before the beam can fire again. While channelling you're anchored in place (easier to track a target); fire it out of water and this cooldown is doubled.
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerElderRal: Puppeteer (elder guardian): its beam marks the target (glowing) and EVERY guardian within this many blocks drops what it's doing and goes for it with Speed II. (A normal guardian's beam is a soft rally: guardians within puppeteerZombieRallyRadius only join in if they aren't already busy.)
witchmod.configuration.puppeteerElderCal: Puppeteer (elder guardian): left-click (attack) is also Call — if fewer than puppeteerElderCallTarget guardians are nearby, more rise from the water around you. Its cooldown.
