witchmod.configuration.bedrockHungryMinT: Bedrock Moment (Hungry): min ticks that right-click eats whatever you're holding.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockCreeperBoa: Bedrock Moment (Charged Creeper Boat): per-tick speed the boat blitzes toward you. Fast — it's about the SHOCK of it screaming at you, not reliably killing.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockBlitzSpeed: Bedrock Moment (Blitz): Speed amplifier given to blitzing creepers (0 = Speed I).
witchmod.configuration.bedrockBlitzDeton: Bedrock Moment (Blitz): distance (blocks) at which a blitzing creeper instantly detonates (no windup).
witchmod.configuration.bedrockMitosisMax: Bedrock Moment (Mitosis): how many nearby mobs duplicate per event.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockMitosisNea: Bedrock Moment (Mitosis): SAFETY cap — skip duplicating if this many mobs are already nearby.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockRubberband: Bedrock Moment (Rubberbanding): how many times it yanks you back to the saved spot.
Bedrock Moment (Rubberbanding): gap (ticks) between each yank-back (short = frantic lag).
witchmod.configuration.bedrockBluetoothT: Bedrock Moment (Bluetooth Damage): how long (ticks) incoming damage is withheld and stored.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockBluetoothR: Bedrock Moment (Bluetooth Damage): delay (ticks) after the window before the stored damage lands all at once.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockHelicopter: Bedrock Moment (Helicopter): min spin-up time (ticks) before the anchored mob is launched (4s).
Bedrock Moment (Helicopter): max spin-up time (ticks) before launch (15s).
Bedrock Moment (Helicopter): upward launch velocity when the spin ends.
Bedrock Moment (Helicopter): a brief ON-GROUND spin grace (ticks) — it whips into a spin where it stands before it starts rising.
Bedrock Moment (Helicopter): degrees per tick it spins — big for a proper blur.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockDrownTicks: Bedrock Moment (Desync Drowning): how long (ticks) the fake drowning lasts before it gives up on its own (also ends on touching water or dying).
witchmod.configuration.bedrockGhostBlock: Bedrock Moment (Ghost Blocks): chance a block you place turns out to be a ghost — it briefly appears then pops out (item still consumed).
Bedrock Moment (Ghost Blocks): how long (ticks) the ghost block lingers before rejecting itself.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockSoundDelay: Bedrock Moment (Sound Delay): how long (ticks) the delayed-audio window lasts.
Bedrock Moment (Sound Delay): how far behind (ticks) sounds lag during the window.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockPhantomDur: Bedrock Moment (Phantom Durability): how long (ticks) your hotbar durability bars jitter for.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockPerspectiv: Bedrock Moment (Perspective Flip): how long (ticks) the camera is yanked to third-person.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockHotbarDrif: Bedrock Moment (Hotbar Drift): chance per ~1.5s that your selected hotbar slot drifts to another on its own.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockMarketplac: Bedrock Moment (Marketplace): how many ad images exist (assets/witchmod/textures/gui/marketplace/ad_1.png .. ad_N.png) to pick from.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockTickspeedM: Bedrock Moment (Tickspeed): how many times faster nearby entities tick (they're TICKED extra times each server tick, mimicking a high-tickspeed/server-lag clip — not a Speed potion).
witchmod.configuration.bedrockTickspeedT: Bedrock Moment (Tickspeed): how long (ticks) nearby entities go haywire-fast.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockDelayFallM: Bedrock Moment (Delay): min delay (ticks) before withheld FALL damage finally lands (0.5s).
Bedrock Moment (Delay): max delay (ticks) before withheld fall damage lands (4s).
witchmod.configuration.bedrockPauseMinTi: Bedrock Moment (Pause): min freeze (ticks) applied to your own projectiles (0.3s).
witchmod.configuration.bedrockPauseMaxTi: Bedrock Moment (Pause): max freeze (ticks) applied to your own projectiles (3s).
witchmod.configuration.bedrockPauseChanc: Bedrock Moment (Pause): chance a projectile you fire freezes mid-flight.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockAimbotVelo: Bedrock Moment (Aimbot): velocity multiplier applied to skeleton arrows near you.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockAimbotHomi: Bedrock Moment (Aimbot): how hard skeleton arrows curve toward you each tick.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockAimbotRadi: Bedrock Moment (Aimbot): radius (blocks) within which skeleton arrows get the aimbot treatment.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockFlingChanc: Bedrock Moment (Fling): chance a rideable entity flings itself the instant you mount it.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockFlingForce: Bedrock Moment (Fling): how hard the mount is flung.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockServerlagT: Bedrock Moment (Server Lag): how long (ticks) nearby entities freeze before snapping back to life.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockNightcoreT: Bedrock Moment (Nightcore): how long (ticks) game sounds play higher-pitched.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockNightcoreP: Bedrock Moment (Nightcore): pitch multiplier applied to sounds during the window.
witchmod.configuration.bedrockChunkrejec: Bedrock Moment (Chunk Rejection): min time (ticks) chunks stop rendering (render distance forced low).
Bedrock Moment (Chunk Rejection): max time (ticks) chunks stop rendering.
Splitscreen: max distance (blocks) to the partner. Beyond it the split ends and you play normally; you re-pair when someone comes back into range.
witchmod.configuration.splitscreenLoadMi: Splitscreen: minimum length (ticks) of the fake 'entering/exiting splitscreen…' loading screen.
witchmod.configuration.splitscreenLoadMa: Splitscreen: maximum length (ticks) of the fake loading screen (0.4–2s by default).
witchmod.configuration.cutawayCooldownSe: Cutaway Gag: minimum real seconds between cutaways. Nothing can fire during this window.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayBaseChance: Cutaway Gag: base % chance PER SECOND to start a cutaway once the cooldown has elapsed.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayRampPerSec: Cutaway Gag: how much the per-second chance ramps up each further second past the cooldown.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayMaxChanceP: Cutaway Gag: cap on the ramping per-second chance.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayGagDelayMi: Cutaway Gag: minimum delay (ticks) after the camera cuts before the gag actually fires.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayGagDelayMa: Cutaway Gag: maximum delay (ticks) before the gag fires (default 0.5–2.5s).
witchmod.configuration.cutawayDurationMi: Cutaway Gag: minimum length (ticks) you keep watching AFTER the gag fires.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayDurationMa: Cutaway Gag: maximum length (ticks) you keep watching after the gag fires (default 6–10s).
witchmod.configuration.cutawayHitEndChan: Cutaway Gag: % chance that taking a hit mid-cutaway snaps your camera back (the gag's effects still stick).
witchmod.configuration.cutawayMarriageTi: Cutaway Gag (Marriage): base length (ticks) of the wedding ceremony (normal path). The objection path runs +220 longer so it stays readable; explode/what are slightly shorter. Deliberately slow.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayMarriageEx: Cutaway Gag (Marriage): explosion power when the 'explode' path fires (slight world damage).
witchmod.configuration.cutawaySpectateDi: Cutaway Gag: horizontal distance (blocks) the overhead spectate camera sits from the victim.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayCameraHeig: Cutaway Gag: how high (blocks) above the victim the overhead spectate camera sits.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayWoolliamCa: Cutaway Gag (Woolliam): max sheep the duplicating flock can reach.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayDrivebyCou: Cutaway Gag (Driveby): number of skeletons in the drive-by.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayJumpedCoun: Cutaway Gag (Jumped): number of buffed mobs that jump the victim.
Cutaway Gag (Hole): how deep the hole is dug beneath the victim.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayLaunchPowe: Cutaway Gag (Launch): upward velocity of the slime-block catapult.
witchmod.configuration.cutawaySnailSpeed: Cutaway Gag (Snail): blocks/tick the fake immortal snail creeps toward the victim.
witchmod.configuration.cutawaySnailDamag: Cutaway Gag (Snail): damage of the non-terrain-damaging explosion when the snail touches you (then the gag ends).
witchmod.configuration.cutawayHelicopter: Cutaway Gag (Helicopter): max degrees/tick the spruce boat spins (it ramps up to this).
Cutaway Gag (Helicopter): max upward blocks/tick the ramping ascent reaches.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayTrainWarni: Cutaway Gag (I Like Trains): ticks the 'I like trains' line plays before the train rolls. Set to roughly the length of the audio clip so it finishes just as the train starts.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayTrainSpeed: Cutaway Gag (I Like Trains): blocks/tick the noclip train barrels along the rails.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayTokyoSpeed: Cutaway Gag (Tokyo Drifting): blocks/tick the cherry boat drifts the victim along the ground.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayPiedPiperM: Cutaway Gag (Pied Piper): minimum animals swarming the victim (spawns to fill the quota).
witchmod.configuration.cutawayFakeTntCou: Cutaway Gag (Fake TNT): how many (mostly fake) TNT drop from above.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayFakeTntRea: Cutaway Fake Tnt Real Chance Percent
Cutaway Gag (Fake TNT): % chance each dropped TNT is a REAL one that actually explodes.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayAbductionH: Cutaway Gag (Abduction): how high (blocks) the UFO/tractor beam towers above the victim.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayAbductionL: Cutaway Gag (Abduction): how long (ticks) the beam yanks the victim upward before dropping them.
Cutaway Gag (Abduction): Levitation amplifier — higher = sucked up faster/higher.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayAquariumCo: Cutaway Gag (Aquarium): how many squids/fish spawn treating air like water.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayTrainCount: Cutaway Gag (I Like Trains): how many minecarts slam down the rails.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayTrainDamag: Cutaway Gag (I Like Trains): damage a cart deals if it hits the victim.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayBowlingDam: Cutaway Gag (Bowling): damage the bowling ball deals to each pin it hits.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayBowlingClu: Cutaway Gag (Bowling): min entities clustered around the victim before Bowling gets its crowd-weighted pick.
Cutaway Gag (Bowling): per-entity chance added toward picking Bowling when the victim is in a crowd (capped 70%).
witchmod.configuration.cutawayParadeCoun: Cutaway Gag (Parade): how many entities march by.
witchmod.configuration.cutawayParadeSpee: Cutaway Gag (Parade): how fast the marchers walk (blocks/tick before friction).
witchmod.configuration.cutawayParadeDama: Cutaway Gag (Parade): damage a marcher deals to anything it tramples over.
witchmod.configuration.dwellerPossessCha: Dweller (Possession): 1-in-N per-tick chance to possess a nearby passive mob (tier 2+).
witchmod.configuration.dwellerPossessCoo: Dweller (Possession): cooldown ticks after a possession before another can start.
witchmod.configuration.dwellerBehindTurn: Dweller (Behind): how sharp a one-tick turn (degrees) counts as a fast look.
witchmod.configuration.dwellerBehindChan: Dweller (Behind): chance a fast turn briefly reveals him (tier 2+).
witchmod.configuration.dwellerBehindCool: Dweller (Behind): cooldown ticks between behind-you glimpses.
witchmod.configuration.dwellerBehindDist: Dweller (Behind): how far ahead of your new look he appears (blocks).
witchmod.configuration.dwellerBehindTick: Dweller (Behind): how long the glimpse lasts before he vanishes (ticks).
witchmod.configuration.heavyHitterKnockb: Heavy Hitter: multiplier on your melee knockback (multiplies the final strength, so it stacks multiplicatively with Knockback enchantments).
witchmod.configuration.heavyHitterFlatDa: Heavy Hitter: flat extra damage added to every melee hit you land (on top of the weapon's own).
witchmod.configuration.speedDemonMountMu: Speed Demon: movement-speed multiplier applied to any LIVING mount you ride (boats/ minecarts aren't attribute-driven, so they're not covered).
witchmod.configuration.narcolepsyMaxInte: Narcolepsy: maximum gap between sleeps (ticks). 6600 = 5.5min. Biased toward the higher half.
witchmod.configuration.narcolepsyMinSlee: Narcolepsy: minimum sleep length (ticks) if you don't mash out. 80 = 4s.
witchmod.configuration.narcolepsyMaxSlee: Narcolepsy: maximum sleep length (ticks) if you don't mash out. 240 = 12s.
witchmod.configuration.narcolepsyIdleAcc: Narcolepsy: after standing still this many ticks, the countdown to the next sleep runs at DOUBLE speed (idling makes a narcoleptic nod off sooner). 60 = 3s.
witchmod.configuration.narcolepsyDeepCha: Narcolepsy: chance (%) a sleep is a DEEP one (needs noticeably more mashing + lasts longer).
witchmod.configuration.narcolepsyVeryDee: Narcolepsy: chance (%) a sleep is a VERY DEEP one (rarer than deep; the hardest to mash out and the longest). Rolled only if the deep roll already passed.
witchmod.configuration.flightRiseSpeed.t: Flight: max upward velocity (blocks/tick) while holding jump (reached after the accel buildup).
Flight: ticks of acceleration buildup from a slow start up to the max rise speed. 20 = 1s.
witchmod.configuration.flightDrainPerTic: Flight: fraction of the energy bar drained per tick while rising (0..1).
witchmod.configuration.flightRegenDelayT: Flight: delay (ticks) after you stop rising before the bar starts refilling. 8 = 0.4s.
witchmod.configuration.flightSprintRiseM: Flight: while sprinting + holding a movement key, the upward rise is scaled by this (you trade height for horizontal speed).
witchmod.configuration.flightSprintHoriz: Flight: horizontal speed (blocks/tick) when sprint-gliding forward.
witchmod.configuration.flightAirborneDra: Flight: a small constant drain per tick just for being airborne (even when not rising), so you can't loiter aloft forever. Refills only once you land.
witchmod.configuration.flightGlideDrainM: Flight: the horizontal sprint-glide drains this multiple of the normal push-up drain (1.5 = 50% more).
witchmod.configuration.flightHoldTicks.t: Flight: jump must be HELD this many ticks before flight engages, so a quick tap is just a normal jump (no flight, no drain). 4 = 0.2s.
witchmod.configuration.flightAirborneGra: Flight: the constant airborne drain only starts after being off the ground this long, so a natural jump never costs resource. 12 = 0.6s.
witchmod.configuration.flightRegenPerTic: Flight: fraction of the energy bar refilled per tick when on the ground / not rising.
witchmod.configuration.flightGlideRegenP: Flight + Elytra: fraction of the energy bar refilled per tick while gliding on an elytra with NO active push-up — this makes Flight a refuelling enhancer for elytra travel.
witchmod.configuration.flightElytraLiftM: Flight + Elytra: how much of the rise speed becomes extra LIFT (added on top of the glide) when you hold jump while gliding — deliberately small, just enough to stop you constantly losing height.
witchmod.configuration.flightElytraSprin: Flight + Elytra: extra forward speed per tick added along your look while HOLDING SPRINT and gliding on an elytra (accumulates against vanilla drag toward a decent glide speed).
witchmod.configuration.flightElytraDrain: Flight + Elytra: the energy drain while actively pushing (lift/sprint) on an elytra is multiplied by this — flying an elytra with the blessing burns the bar faster.
witchmod.configuration.flightElytraFov.t: Flight + Elytra: FOV multiplier applied while sprint-gliding on an elytra (a slight zoom-out for the sense of speed). 1.0 = no change.
Flight: fraction of the energy bar drained when you take damage (0.2 = 20%).
witchmod.configuration.flightLockoutTick: Flight: ticks you're knocked out of flight after taking damage. 12 = 0.6s.
witchmod.configuration.thunderTier1Ticks: Thunder: seconds of not-swinging to reach charge tier 1/2/3/4 (in ticks).
Thunder: flat base damage every chain deals BEFORE the % of the hit is added on.
witchmod.configuration.thunderChainPerce: Thunder: chain damage as a % of the base hit damage, added on top of thunderChainBase.
witchmod.configuration.thunderChainCap.t: Thunder: hard cap on any single chain's damage.
witchmod.configuration.thunderChainRange: Thunder: how far (blocks) a chain can jump to the next entity.
Thunder: burn applied to hit + chained entities (ticks). 60 = 3s.
witchmod.configuration.thunderTier4Bonus: Thunder: bonus damage on the initial hit at tier 4.
Spelunking: small, constant radius (blocks) to scan + highlight nearby ores.
witchmod.configuration.spelunkingInterva: Spelunking: how often (ticks) it re-scans and marks nearby ores (frequent = a constant glow).
witchmod.configuration.safetyChannelTick: Safety: ticks of crouching still + looking down before you teleport home. 200 = 10s.
witchmod.configuration.safetyCooldownTic: Safety: cooldown (ticks) after a cancelled channel before you can try again. 120 = 6s.
witchmod.configuration.safetyUseCooldown: Safety: cooldown (ticks) after a SUCCESSFUL teleport home. 7200 = 6 minutes.
witchmod.configuration.disguiseBreakRadi: Disguise: get this close (blocks) to a hostile and the costume breaks.
witchmod.configuration.disguiseReturnTic: Disguise: ticks you must go un-hit after a break before the costume returns. 240 = 12s.
witchmod.configuration.concealFlashTicks: Concealment synergy (Prop Hunt + Disguise): ticks you're briefly unrendered (armour and all) after a form change, so a switch reads as a puff-of-smoke vanish.
witchmod.configuration.fishFlopPower.too: Fish disguise (Disguise + a water effect): out of water you FLOP with the same cadence as a vanilla fish — hopping the instant you land, so you bounce continuously. This is the upward power of each hop (vanilla's fish flop is 0.4).
witchmod.configuration.batFlySpeed.toolt: Bat disguise (Sanguine + Disguise): the fly speed while bat-flying, slow by default (vanilla creative fly is 0.05). You can't sprint-fly on your own — pair it with the Flight blessing for that.
witchmod.configuration.batFlightSprintSp: Bat disguise + Flight blessing: the fly speed while SPRINT-flying (vanilla then doubles it in the air), so the Flight blessing lets a bat dash about quickly.
witchmod.configuration.confusionInterval: Confusion: how often (ticks) a doppelganger may be emitted.
witchmod.configuration.confusionMaxClone: Confusion: max live doppelgangers at once.
witchmod.configuration.confusionCloneLif: Confusion: how long (ticks) a doppelganger lives before poofing.
witchmod.configuration.confusionAttackSp: Confusion: how many extra clones a hit forces out over the following window, bypassing the usual audience/rarity gate — so getting attacked always throws up decoys. Still capped by confusionMaxClones.
Confusion: the window the forced attack-clones spawn over. 40 = 2 seconds.
witchmod.configuration.confusionBatFlySp: Confusion: how fast a clone flies while the owner is bat-disguised (blocks/tick of steering), so a swarm of bat-clones flits around you.
witchmod.configuration.photosynthesisInt: Photosynthesis: how often (ticks) sunlight tops you up. 40 = 2s.
witchmod.configuration.voodooDollDurabil: Voodoo Doll: max durability, applied when a doll is bound. Deliberately LOW — voodoo is pretty much free damage, so a doll only lasts a few interactions.
witchmod.configuration.voodooTrackRadius: Voodoo Doll (tracker): while you hold a bound doll and the target is ONLINE, in the same dimension and within this many blocks, a subtle particle points toward them.
witchmod.configuration.voodooUnprotected: Voodoo damage: the fraction of the hit that IGNORES armour. 0.5 = half the damage is always unprotected, so armour helps but only half as much as against a normal hit.
witchmod.configuration.voodooNeedleBaseD: Voodoo Needle: jab damage (before the half-armour reduction).
witchmod.configuration.voodooNeedleDollC: Voodoo Needle: durability spent from the doll per jab.
witchmod.configuration.voodooLavaFireTic: Voodoo Doll: how long (ticks) the bound player burns when the doll is destroyed in fire/lava.
Voodoo Doll: how hard the victim is flung when you throw (drop) the doll.
witchmod.configuration.voodooThrowDollCo: Voodoo Doll: durability spent when you throw the doll to fling the victim (a lot).
witchmod.configuration.voodooSqueezeTick: Voodoo Doll (squeeze): ticks between each damage/slow 'click' while holding right-click.
witchmod.configuration.voodooSqueezeBase: Voodoo Doll (squeeze): damage of the first tick; it ramps up each tick.
witchmod.configuration.voodooSqueezeRamp: Voodoo Doll (squeeze): extra damage added per successive tick.
witchmod.configuration.voodooSqueezeDoll: Voodoo Doll (squeeze): durability spent per damage tick (a lot over a full squeeze).
witchmod.configuration.voodooSqueezeCool: Voodoo Doll (squeeze): item-use cooldown (ticks) after a squeeze ends.
witchmod.configuration.voodooFeedDollCos: Voodoo Doll (feeding): durability spent to feed the victim. 0 = free (it's a kindness).
Voodoo Doll: camera-shake window (ticks) on the CASTER when they pin/squeeze the doll.
witchmod.configuration.voodooShakeStreng: Voodoo Doll: camera-shake strength on the caster per pin/squeeze click.
witchmod.configuration.voodooSqueezeSelf: Voodoo Doll (squeeze): Slowness amplifier on the CASTER while squeezing (movement penalty).
witchmod.configuration.voodooPotionDollC: Voodoo Doll: durability spent per scan while a grounded doll sits in a lingering potion cloud.
witchmod.configuration.voodooFishingForc: Voodoo Doll: how hard the victim is flung when a FISHING ROD is used on the grounded doll (much stronger than a throw).
witchmod.configuration.voodooFishingDoll: Voodoo Doll: durability spent when a fishing rod yanks the victim (a HUGE amount).
witchmod.configuration.voodooFishingRang: Voodoo Doll: how far (blocks) a used fishing rod looks for a bound doll in front of you.
witchmod.configuration.voodooTableDollCo: Voodoo Doll: durability spent when used AS a Player Essence in the Bewitching Table target slot (the doll is returned, not consumed).
witchmod.configuration.lightweightKnockb: Lightweight: multiplier on knockback dealt TO you. Stacks on top of the attacker's own Knockback enchants/enhancements.
witchmod.configuration.munchiesSaturatio: Munchies: percent of the SATURATION a food would give that you actually keep (lower = you have to eat far more often).
witchmod.configuration.munchiesEatSpeedP: Munchies: percent faster you eat. Stacks with Gluttony's own eat-speed boost.
witchmod.configuration.spotlightBeamHeig: Spotlight: how tall (blocks) the beam of light raining down onto you is (measured from the beam's start above your head, see spotlightBeamGap).
Spotlight: how far above your head the beam STARTS, so it isn't in your face / blocking your view.
witchmod.configuration.spotlightDetectio: Spotlight: radius within which hostile mobs get a follow-range boost so they spot you more easily (stacks with other curses' detection boosts). 0 to disable.
Spotlight: extra follow-range (blocks) granted to nearby hostiles so they see you easier.
witchmod.configuration.hiccupsMinGapTick: Hiccups: minimum ticks between hiccups (outside a fit).
witchmod.configuration.hiccupsMaxGapTick: Hiccups: maximum ticks between hiccups (outside a fit).
witchmod.configuration.hiccupsHopPower.t: Hiccups: upward velocity of the involuntary hop (0.42 ~= a vanilla jump).
witchmod.configuration.hiccupsFitChanceP: Hiccups: chance a hiccup spirals into a whole FIT of several in a row.
witchmod.configuration.hiccupsFitMin.too: Hiccups: fewest EXTRA hiccups in a fit.
witchmod.configuration.hiccupsFitMax.too: Hiccups: most EXTRA hiccups in a fit.
witchmod.configuration.hiccupsFitSpacing: Hiccups: ticks between hiccups WITHIN a fit.
witchmod.configuration.hiccupsFreezeTick: Hiccups: how many ticks each hiccup briefly freezes your movement for.
witchmod.configuration.bodySwapMinGapTic: Body Swapping: minimum ticks between swaps.
witchmod.configuration.bodySwapMaxGapTic: Body Swapping: maximum ticks between swaps.
witchmod.configuration.bodySwapRadius.to: Body Swapping: farthest a swap partner can be.
witchmod.configuration.bodySwapMinDistan: Body Swapping: nearest a swap partner can be — keeps it from swapping with someone right next to you (so it's a real relocation).
witchmod.configuration.bodySwapCloneChan: Body Swapping: chance a swap targets a nearby Confusion clone instead of a player (so it can swap you with your own decoys — deliberately lower than swapping with a real player). 0 disables it.
witchmod.configuration.bodySwapSpecialCh: Body Swapping: chance a swap becomes a 'special swap' — one of fake-out / flicker / long-distance / frenzy — instead of an ordinary one-off swap. 0 disables the special swaps.
witchmod.configuration.bodySwapFakeoutDe: Body Swapping FAKE-OUT: ticks after the first swap before it swaps you again. 30 = 1.5 seconds.
witchmod.configuration.bodySwapFlickerDu: Body Swapping FLICKER: total length of the flicker window with one fixed target. 200 = 10 seconds.
witchmod.configuration.bodySwapFlickerIn: Body Swapping FLICKER: ticks between each swap roll during the window. 20 = once per second.
witchmod.configuration.bodySwapFlickerCh: Body Swapping FLICKER: chance PER roll to swap with the fixed target.
witchmod.configuration.bodySwapLongDista: Body Swapping LONG-DISTANCE: farthest a long-distance partner can be (they must be beyond the normal bodySwapRadius). A big relocation across the map.
witchmod.configuration.backseatSpeedDemo: Synergy (Backseat Driver + Speed Demon): extra Speed levels given to a hijacked mount while both are active. Added on top of backseatSpeedBoostLevel.
witchmod.configuration.pestsPopularityMu: Synergy (Pests + Popularity): the per-block silverfish chance is multiplied by this while both are active, so mining during a Popularity horde is crawling with them.
Synergy (Gassy + Unhygienic): radius of the extra stink cloud a fart kicks up — players inside are shoved away and non-undead mobs are sped up to flee.
Synergy (Gassy + Unhygienic): how hard the stink cloud shoves nearby players away (a big fart shoves harder).
witchmod.configuration.hiccupsFartChance: Synergy (Hiccups + Gassy): chance each hiccup DURING A FIT also lets out a fart while both are active.
witchmod.configuration.windfallHighTierC: Synergy (Windfall + Luck): chance a windfall floats a SPECIAL high-tier item (diamonds, golden apples, ...) instead of the ordinary good pool while both are active. Junk is skipped entirely.
witchmod.configuration.companionshipBant: Companionship banter: shortest gap (ticks) between banter lines when a player carries a mix of Bodyguard / Solicitor / Guardian Angel. 400 = 20s.
Companionship banter: longest gap (ticks) between banter lines. 900 = 45s.
witchmod.configuration.companionshipArgu: Companionship banter: delay (ticks) before the reply lands in an 'argue' exchange. 40 = 2s.
witchmod.configuration.companionshipDeat: Companionship banter: chance the surviving companion remarks when the bodyguard, solicitor or guardian angel is killed. Kept low so it stays an occasional touch.
witchmod.configuration.leftHandedDriftDe: Left Handed: amplitude (degrees) of the PATTERNED aim sway that bites while aiming/using ANY item (bow, trident, spyglass, ...). 0 = no sway, just the flipped hand + scrambled chat.
witchmod.configuration.leftHandedProject: Left Handed: slight extra spread added to anything you throw/shoot (steers the aim only, the speed is preserved). 0 disables it.
witchmod.configuration.iceSkatesSlip.too: Ice Skates: how much horizontal momentum is retained each tick when you let go of the controls (higher = a longer, more prominent glide; 1.0 would never stop).
witchmod.configuration.iceSkatesSprintSl: Ice Skates: the retained-momentum factor used when you were SPRINTING as you let go — a longer skid off the back of a sprint. Should be >= iceSkatesSlip.
witchmod.configuration.iceSkatesCap.tool: Ice Skates: horizontal speed cap while sliding (walking release).
witchmod.configuration.iceSkatesSprintCa: Ice Skates: horizontal speed cap while sliding off a sprint (a faster skid).
witchmod.configuration.vertigoCameraStar: Vertigo: Y at which the CAMERA sway begins (a slight sway, growing with height).
witchmod.configuration.vertigoMovementSt: Vertigo: Y at which a MOVEMENT sway ALSO kicks in (your feet start to wander), growing with height on top of the camera sway.
witchmod.configuration.vertigoMaxY.toolt: Vertigo: Y at which both sways reach full strength (the height limit).
witchmod.configuration.vertigoCameraStre: Vertigo: peak camera wobble in degrees at maxY.
witchmod.configuration.vertigoMovementSt: Vertigo: peak movement sway at maxY, as a fraction of full strafe (like Wonky's drift).
witchmod.configuration.narratorHearRadiu: Narrator: how close another player must be to also have their client speak the line (each hears it flat/non-positional — TTS isn't a world sound).
witchmod.configuration.narratorEventChan: Narrator: percent chance an eligible event actually gets narrated (so it doesn't comment on literally everything).
witchmod.configuration.narratorAmbientMi: Narrator: minimum ticks between ambient (idle) narration lines.
witchmod.configuration.narratorAmbientMa: Narrator: maximum ticks between ambient (idle) narration lines.
witchmod.configuration.narratorRepeatGap: Narrator anti-spam: for a SUSTAINED activity (same category over and over, e.g. swimming), each repeat adds this many ticks to the required gap, so it slows down the longer it drags on. Resets the moment a different reaction fires.
Narrator anti-spam: the ceiling the escalating same-category gap grows to.
witchmod.configuration.narratorVariantCa: Narrator anti-spam: how many times ONE specific line may be spoken during a single same-category run before it's retired; once every variant is used up the category goes silent until a different reaction happens.
witchmod.configuration.narratorSubtitleT: Narrator: how long the on-screen subtitle for the spoken line lingers, in ticks per character (it's removed as soon as the line is done). Makes it accessible for non-Windows.
witchmod.configuration.narratorCalloutCh: Narrator: percent chance a spoken line's subtitle is replaced (on non-Windows clients only) by an OS jab from linux_mac_callout instead of the readable line.
witchmod.configuration.narratorTabSpamSe: Narrator: once tabbed out longer than this many seconds, it starts narrating CONSTANTLY (ignoring the anti-spam escalation) until you come back — being deliberately annoying.
witchmod.configuration.narratorTabSpamIn: Narrator: how often (ticks) the constant tabbed-out spam fires once past the threshold.
witchmod.configuration.narratorPostLineG: Narrator Post Line Gap Max Ticks

Narrator: the gap between lines is a random 0..this many ticks AFTER the previous line is estimated to finish speaking (20 = 1s, so the default 40 = up to 2s). Lines flow one after another rather than on a fixed floor.
witchmod.configuration.narratorEnvChance: Narrator: percent chance, on an idle/ambient tick with a surrounding condition present (rain, night, nearby mobs, deep underground, ...), to comment on the SURROUNDINGS instead of the player — kept low so it sprinkles in and never starves the idle/ambient lines.
witchmod.configuration.narratorDarkLight: Narrator: the 'dark' surroundings line only fires when the EFFECTIVE light level (block + any propagated daylight) at the victim is at or below this — so standing in daylight never triggers a 'place a torch' jab.
witchmod.configuration.leaderRadius.tool: Leader: radius within which OTHER players (not you) get Regeneration + Resistance.
witchmod.configuration.leaderRegenAmplif: Leader: Regeneration amplifier granted to nearby allies (0 = Regen I).
witchmod.configuration.leaderResistanceA: Leader: Resistance amplifier granted to nearby allies (0 = Resistance I).
witchmod.configuration.underdogHalfPerce: Underdog: health percent at/below which the FIRST tier of buffs kicks in.
witchmod.configuration.underdogQuarterPe: Underdog: health percent at/below which the STRONGER tier kicks in.
Bloodhound: how far you can 'scent' entities (their-eyes-only particles, even on invisible ones).
witchmod.configuration.bloodhoundFootste: Bloodhound: how far (blocks) an entity must move before it drops a footstep breadcrumb.
witchmod.configuration.bloodhoundLingerT: Bloodhound: how long (ticks) each footstep stays lit — the trail is re-sent so it lingers. 100 = 5s.
witchmod.configuration.guardianRespawnTi: Guardian Angel: ticks before a killed allay returns (6000 = 5 minutes).
witchmod.configuration.guardianSpeed.too: Guardian Angel: the allay's movement speed cap (blocks/tick). High = fast + hard to hit.
witchmod.configuration.guardianEventMinT: Guardian Angel: minimum ticks between scheduled (passive) events — buffs / item-fetch.
witchmod.configuration.guardianEventMaxT: Guardian Angel: maximum ticks between scheduled (passive) events.
witchmod.configuration.guardianDetectRad: Guardian Angel: radius it watches for attackers, items and lit TNT.
witchmod.configuration.guardianFishingHu: Guardian Angel (Fishing): extra ticks shaved off the bite timer per tick while it hovers your bobber (stacks with Angler).
witchmod.configuration.guardianHasteSeco: Guardian Angel (Mining): seconds of Haste II granted when you break a hard block or a run of blocks.
witchmod.configuration.guardianDurabilit: Guardian Angel (Durability): % of max durability restored to every worn/held/stored tool when it tends your gear.
witchmod.configuration.guardianCursePurg: Guardian Angel (Curse purge): % chance, each opportunity (~every 30s while you carry a curse), to lift one random curse.
witchmod.configuration.guardianPhantomRa: Guardian Angel (Phantom purge): radius within which it flies up and vaporises phantoms.
witchmod.configuration.guardianBuffMinSe: Guardian Angel (Buffs): minimum seconds for each of the 1-3 random buffs it bestows.
witchmod.configuration.guardianBuffMaxSe: Guardian Angel (Buffs): maximum seconds for each random buff.
witchmod.configuration.guardianKidnapDro: Guardian Angel (Kidnap): how high it hauls an attacker before dropping them (only below 40% health).
witchmod.configuration.guardianKidnapHaz: Guardian Angel (Kidnap): how high above a hazard (lava/fire) it releases you, so there's room for counterplay.
witchmod.configuration.guardianKidnapCoo: Guardian Angel (Kidnap): ticks between kidnaps (otherwise a hit just makes it panic).
witchmod.configuration.guardianKidnapLav: Guardian Angel (Kidnap): if lava is within this radius of the attacker, they get dropped INTO it instead.
witchmod.configuration.guardianRareGiftC: Guardian Angel (Blessing gift): % chance per ambient opportunity to bestow ONE random blessing (once per blessing, biased to low power).
Guardian Angel (Heal): health per second knit up while it flies the healing star around you (below half health; a hit cancels it).
witchmod.configuration.guardianSurroundC: Guardian Angel (Knockback): how many nearby entities count as 'surrounded', triggering the pinball knockback.
witchmod.configuration.guardianKnockback: Guardian Angel (Knockback): how hard it flings entities away when it pinballs to give you space.
witchmod.configuration.guardianAntigrief: Guardian Angel (Anti-grief): radius within which it grabs and flings away a lit creeper / primed TNT.
witchmod.configuration.guardianAbsorptio: Guardian Angel (Grace aura): extra Absorption hearts kept topped up while you're out of combat (0 = off).
witchmod.configuration.guardianAuraInter: Guardian Angel (Grace aura): ticks between aura top-ups (absorption + out-of-combat regen).
witchmod.configuration.guardianSacrifice: Guardian Angel (Sacrifice): a killing blow is negated and the guardian dies in your place (returns after the respawn cooldown).
witchmod.configuration.guardianZapDamage: Guardian Angel (Zap): damage to the FIRST target of a chain bolt (chained foes take less).
witchmod.configuration.guardianZapCooldo: Guardian Angel (Zap): ticks between zaps (only fires while in combat; it chains, so it's less frequent).
witchmod.configuration.guardianZapChainM: Guardian Angel (Zap): how many extra foes each bolt arcs through (whittles a group instead of one target).
witchmod.configuration.guardianZapChainR: Guardian Angel (Zap): max distance the bolt can arc from one foe to the next.
witchmod.configuration.guardianZapChainF: Guardian Angel (Zap): damage retained per chain jump (0.7 = each foe takes 70% of the last).
witchmod.configuration.guardianAllayHeal: Guardian Angel: the allay's max health in HP (10 = 5 hearts).
witchmod.configuration.guardianAllayRege: Guardian Angel: ticks the allay must go un-hit before it regenerates fast (60 = 3s).
witchmod.configuration.guardianGuidingBo: Guardian Angel (Guiding light): bonus damage you deal to the highlighted highest-health foe (3 = 1.5 hearts).
witchmod.configuration.guardianGuidingMi: Guardian Angel (Guiding light): how many nearby foes count as a 'group' before it highlights one.
witchmod.configuration.guardianBlindingC: Guardian Angel (Blinding light): ticks between the charge-and-launch strike (only near enemies).
witchmod.configuration.guardianEscortHea: Guardian Angel (Escort): at/below this % health (with danger near) it lifts you and flies you to safety.
witchmod.configuration.guardianTorchInte: Guardian Angel (Light-keeper): ticks between torch-placing passes while it's dark/night (lower = more torches).
witchmod.configuration.guardianTorchSpac: Guardian Angel (Light-keeper): minimum block spacing between placed torches.
witchmod.configuration.ritualMinDuration: Ritual Table: minimum rolled effect duration in ticks (42000 = 35 min).
witchmod.configuration.ritualMaxDuration: Ritual Table: maximum rolled effect duration in ticks (72000 = 60 min).
witchmod.configuration.ritualDurationNoV: When true, effect durations have NO random variation — every cast lasts exactly the maximum (ritualMaxDurationTicks) instead of a random roll between min and max. Set the min and max equal for a different fixed value.
witchmod.configuration.ritualInfectiousD: Ritual Table: fixed duration for a spread Infectious modifier in ticks (72000 = 60 min).
witchmod.configuration.dragonsBreathRadi: Dragon's Breath modifier: radius (blocks) of the quarter-dose splash + its visual shockwave ring.
witchmod.configuration.bellAoeRadius.too: Amethyst Bell: how far the ring's gamble reaches players.
witchmod.configuration.bellInactiveTicks: Amethyst Bell: dimension-wide recharge after a ring, in ticks (36000 = 30 min).
witchmod.configuration.bellApplyRampTick: Amethyst Bell: 'consume' ramp before effects land, in ticks (60 = 3s).
witchmod.configuration.bellFizzleRampTic: Amethyst Bell: lighter ramp before a pre-decided fizzle, in ticks (30 = 1.5s).
witchmod.configuration.bellShakeTicks.to: Amethyst Bell: camera-shake window for nearby players on ring, in ticks.
witchmod.configuration.bellShakeStrength: Amethyst Bell: camera-shake strength on ring.
witchmod.configuration.bellShakeRadius.t: Amethyst Bell: how far the ring's camera shake reaches.
witchmod.configuration.bellAddChancePerc: Amethyst Bell: chance an unaffected player is GIFTED a batch (rest fizzle).
Amethyst Bell (gift count weight): weight for 1 effect.
Amethyst Bell (gift count weight): weight for 2 effects (remainder = 3).
witchmod.configuration.bellPowerLowWeigh: Amethyst Bell (gift power band): weight for a low roll (0-40).
witchmod.configuration.bellPowerMidWeigh: Amethyst Bell (gift power band): weight for a mid roll (41-70; remainder = high 71-85).
witchmod.configuration.bellSwapHighChanc: Amethyst Bell (re-roll): chance a swap bumps power UP toward the max.
witchmod.configuration.bellSwapLowChance: Amethyst Bell (re-roll): chance a swap crashes power down (even to 0).
witchmod.configuration.bellSwapSimilarJi: Amethyst Bell (re-roll): power +/- jitter on an ordinary similar-power swap.
Amethyst Bell (re-roll): the highest power a swap can reach.
witchmod.configuration.jarDropsEnabled.t: Master switch for named-jar drops (jars of effects) from loot chests and mob kills. Turn this off to disable ALL special mob drops (jars/coins/grenade) entirely — witch essence still drops.
witchmod.configuration.jarChestDropsEnab: Whether named jars appear in LOOT CHESTS (the per-chest 1-in-N chances below). Requires jarDropsEnabled.
witchmod.configuration.jarMobDropsEnable: Whether the rare SPECIAL drop (jar/coin/grenade) can drop from MOB KILLS. Requires jarDropsEnabled. Witch essence still trickles regardless of this.
witchmod.configuration.specialDropRequir: If true, the rare SPECIAL mob drop (jar/coin/grenade) only rolls when a player lands the killing blow — so it can't clog mob farms (where mobs are killed by fall/lava/other mobs). Off = the old 'recently hit by a player' rule.
witchmod.configuration.jarRarityWeightBa: How much a jar's rarity (1-10) nudges its odds when a drop rolls. Pick weight = base^(5.5 - rarity), CENTRED on mid-rarity, so 1.0 = every jar equally likely and higher values only gently lean commons up / rares down. Kept small (1.12 ≈ ±65% across the whole range) since the pool is large.
witchmod.configuration.jarRarityOverride: Per-jar rarity overrides as "jarId=rarity" (1-10), e.g. "mining=6". Anything not listed keeps its built-in rarity. Only the pick weight changes; the drop rates are the rates below.
witchmod.configuration.jarWitchDropOneIn: A slain witch yields a SPECIAL drop (a prefilled jar or a coin) with a 1-in-N chance (requires a recent player hit). 0 disables.
witchmod.configuration.jarUndeadDropOneI: Any other slain undead mob yields a SPECIAL drop (jar or coin) with a 1-in-N chance (requires a recent player hit). 0 disables.
witchmod.configuration.specialDropCoinCh: When a special drop rolls, the chance it's a COIN (one of Cursed/Blessed/Executioner's) instead of a prefilled jar. 40 = 40%.
witchmod.configuration.witchEssenceRolls: How many independent rolls a slain witch makes for a Cursed Essence drop (each at witchEssenceRollChancePercent). 2 rolls at 33% => 0-2 essence, farmable, so the mod stays present.
witchmod.configuration.witchEssenceRollC: The chance PER ROLL that a slain witch drops one Cursed Essence. 33 = 1/3.
witchmod.configuration.jarChestAncientCi: Jar Chest Ancient City One In
Ancient city chests: 1-in-N chance to also contain a named jar (the likeliest chest source). 0 disables.
witchmod.configuration.jarChestShipwreck: Shipwreck treasure chests: 1-in-N chance to also contain a named jar. 0 disables.
witchmod.configuration.jarChestDungeonOn: Dungeon (monster room) chests: 1-in-N chance to also contain a named jar. 0 disables.
witchmod.configuration.jarChestTempleOne: Temple (desert pyramid / jungle temple) chests: 1-in-N chance to also contain a named jar. 0 disables.
witchmod.configuration.jarChestIglooOneI: Igloo basement chests: 1-in-N chance to also contain a named jar. 0 disables.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeSpecialDro: When a mob's special drop rolls, the 1-in-N chance it's a Holy Hand Grenade instead of the usual coin/jar. Checked FIRST, so 100 => ~1% of special drops are the grenade. 0 disables.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeThrowSpeed: How hard the grenade is lobbed (a snowball is 1.5). Kept low so it arcs like a thrown grenade, not a bullet.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeGravity.to: Downward pull per tick on the thrown grenade (a dropped item is 0.04) — high enough that it clearly arcs DOWN.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeBounce.too: How much of its downward speed the grenade keeps when it bounces off the floor — a subtle, mostly-visual hop (0 = no bounce).
Hard cap on the rebound speed of a bounce, so a fast impact can never launch it skyward.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeWallBounce: How much speed the grenade keeps when it caroms off a wall.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeChargeMome: Fraction of its velocity the grenade keeps when the charge-up starts — it mostly settles then.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeShockwaveV: How long the expanding shockwave RING takes to reach its full radius (the amethyst-bell visual).
witchmod.configuration.grenadeShakeTicks: Camera-shake window (ticks) for the detonation impact jolt.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeShakeStren: Peak camera-shake strength (degrees) for the detonation impact jolt; the shockwave overtake reuses this at a small window for a gentle rattle.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeShakeRadiu: How far the detonation's impact camera-shake reaches.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeShimmerTic: How long the grenade is just a shimmer of glowing particles before the halleluiah + charge.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeChargeTick: How long the grenade pulls in the shimmer (blessed from the skies) before it detonates.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeHallelujah: 1-in-N chance the rare halleluiah replaces the usual one on charge-up.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeExplosionP: The detonation's explosion power (TNT is 4.0 — kept a touch smaller here).
witchmod.configuration.grenadeBlockDamag: Whether the detonation damages the world (still gated on the mobGriefing gamerule too).
witchmod.configuration.grenadeExplosionC: Radius within which the detonation instantly + fully cleanses players and protects them.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeExplosionP: How long players caught in the detonation are protected (instant, full cleanse).
witchmod.configuration.grenadeShockwaveR: How far the cleansing shockwave reaches in every direction.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeShockwaveT: How long the shockwave 'overtake' lasts before the pulse + full cleanse (like the amethyst bell).
witchmod.configuration.grenadeShockwaveD: How many ticks of effect time are burned off PER TICK while the shockwave overtakes you (timers tick QUICK).
witchmod.configuration.grenadeShockwaveP: How long a shockwave-hit player is protected after the final pulse.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeShockwaveR: How long the shockwave's Regeneration II lasts.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeLashKillRa: The live grenade kills any jar lashes that stray within this radius of it.
witchmod.configuration.grenadeUndeadDama: Holy blast damage dealt to undead is multiplied by this (the Killer Bunny is always one-shot regardless).
witchmod.configuration.grenadeShockwaveU: Holy damage the wider shockwave deals to undead mobs it reaches (the Killer Bunny is one-shot regardless).
witchmod.configuration.cameraShakeMultip: Multiplier on ALL screen shake this mod produces (Heavyweight/Dense collapses, Flat Footed footsteps, Brute smashes, the Dweller, Gladiator parries, the Voodoo Doll, the Amethyst Bell, the Holy Hand Grenade, Vertigo's camera sway). 1.0 = full, 0.5 = half, 0.0 = no shake at all.
witchmod.configuration.screenShaderInten: Strength of the mod's full-screen colour effects — the Dweller's desaturation, Siren's Call's magenta wash, the Dweller chase red vignette. 1.0 = full, 0.0 = none. Does not touch the world fog.
witchmod.configuration.disableFullscreen: Hard-disable the GPU post-process shaders (the Dweller desaturation and the Bedrock Moment 'vibrant' saturation boost). Use this if post shaders cause performance or compatibility trouble; the lighter colour tints are governed by screenShaderIntensity instead.
witchmod.configuration.reduceFlashing.to: Photosensitivity: greatly dampen sudden bright flashes (the Dweller jumpscare white flash, the Immortality/Last Stand revive flash, the Bedrock Moment fake-BSOD glitch). Strongly recommended if flashing imagery affects you.
witchmod.configuration.particleDensityMu: Multiplier on the mod's heaviest client-rendered particle effects (the Guardian Angel trail/halo, the Spotlight pillar, the Holy Hand Grenade shimmer, the Leader ring). 1.0 = current density (the default), lower values thin them out for weaker machines. Does not affect gameplay.
witchmod.configuration.compendiumOpenToL: When true, opening the Compendium returns you to the last chapter you were reading instead of the first. Off by default.
witchmod.configuration.optOutScreensaver: Opt out of the Screensaver curse (the game drops out of fullscreen and bounces the window around).
witchmod.configuration.optOutMinorInconv: Opt out of the Minor Inconvenience curse (can't go fullscreen; the window is renamed silly things).
witchmod.configuration.optOutChannels.to: Opt out of the Channels curse (left/right positional audio is swapped).
witchmod.configuration.optOutLoadingScre: Opt out of the Loading Screen curse (a fake loading screen locks your input at every door).
witchmod.configuration.optOutNarrator.to: Opt out of the Narrator curse (a text-to-speech voice reads out your every move).
witchmod.configuration.splitscreenLivePo: Splitscreen: render the partner's LIVE point of view in the side panel (a real second render pass). EXPERIMENTAL — off by default. When off, the panel shows a 'PLAYER 2' screen (partner name + live position/facing) and everything else works. Set true to try the live POV.
witchmod.configuration.title: Jinx Configs
witchmod.subtitle.pacing_theme: Hold on we gotta see these reactions
witchmod.compendium.pandoras_box.desc: A secret curse, revealed only to those who have found every other. The box holds three random curses on its victim at once, on top of the usual limit, and every minute and a half swaps the oldest out for another. More curses than anyone should carry, and no say in which.
witchmod.compendium.pandoras_box.rumour: Some say there's a box that holds every misfortune there is. You would need to know them all before you could ever hope to open it.
witchmod.compendium.shadow.desc: Your shadow comes loose and follows your exact path a few seconds behind you, clawing its way up out of the ground first. Stand still too long and it catches up, and its touch is fatal. It can't follow you into water, can't touch anyone else, and won't rise right on top of you, but if it loses you, it simply comes back.
witchmod.compendium.shadow.rumour: Keep moving. Whatever you do, keep moving.
witchmod.compendium.cornucopia.desc: A secret blessing, revealed only to those who have found every other. The horn pours three random blessings onto its bearer at once, on top of the usual limit, trading the oldest for a new one every minute and a half.
witchmod.compendium.cornucopia.rumour: A horn that never empties, for someone who already knows every gift there is.
witchmod.compendium.puppeteer.desc: Crouch and right-click a zombie (any kind, even a baby), skeleton (wither skeletons too), spider, creeper, pig, cow, mooshroom, sheep, chicken, bat, squid, guardian (elder too), hoglin, zoglin, dolphin, axolotl, phantom, iron golem, snow golem, villager, rabbit (even the killer bunny), silverfish, endermite, enderman, horse (zombie and skeleton ones too), donkey, mule, slime, magma cube, llama, ghast, blaze, breeze, witch, camel, goat, pillager, vindicator, evoker, fox, zombified piglin or fish to possess it. You see through its eyes. You become it: its health, speed, reach and bite, and it takes your damage instead of you, though your own blessings and curses come along for the ride. Each has a move, shown in the corner: zombies Rally (husks raise husks), drowned throw tridents, creepers hold to explode, skeletons draw a real bow, chickens lay or hurl explosive eggs, guardians fire a laser you aim yourself that ends in a burst, hoglins and zoglins lunge, dolphins inspire, axolotls play dead, phantoms dive, iron golems offer poppies, snow golems unleash snowball volleys, villagers open shop, killer bunnies maul, silverfish hide in stone, endermites burrow through it, endermen teleport (and carry blocks), horses can be ridden by your friends, slimes split rather than die, llamas spit, ghasts lob fireballs, blazes fire volleys, breezes blow everything away, witches brew from a potion belt, camels dash, goats ram absurdly hard, pillagers shoot real crossbows, vindicators simply hit very hard (here's Johnny!), evokers conjure fangs and vexes, turn villagers into witches and blow a horn that sets every illager on your target, foxes steal what you're holding, fish leap (and flop helplessly on land), and the rest make a lot of noise. Anything a zombie kills rises infected. Crouch and right-click to step out.
witchmod.compendium.puppeteer.rumour: Why fight the horde when you could wear one of them?
witchmod.compendium.allergic.desc: The target becomes allergic to a food group decided by the time of day it was cast: plants in the morning, meat in the afternoon and evening, magic food and potions at night. Being near the allergen (certain blocks, animals, people, or the food itself) sets off a green, three-tier reaction that takes hearts, slows attacks and clouds your vision. Eating it is even worse.
witchmod.compendium.allergic.rumour: I've heard people speak of allergies; I'm too cool to get them but I could force it on others using some sort of ground berry.
witchmod.compendium.amethyst_bell.desc: A ringable gambling bell where ringing it affects nearby players differently; players with no curses/blessings have a small chance to be handed a random batch, and anyone who already carry some have each one re-rolled for another of the same category at a similar power (with rare deviations). After each ring it goes inactive for 30 minutes.
witchmod.compendium.anchor.desc: A blessing that makes you an anchor, you cannot be moved by any external forces.
witchmod.compendium.anchor.rumour: Texts speak of an immovable figure, able to take on armies, only wearing chains.
witchmod.compendium.angler.desc: A good blessing for when you have Gone Fishing; Greatly increases chances for a fishing bite and drops from fishing.
witchmod.compendium.angler.rumour: Old fishermen speak of a way to substantially increase your fishing luck when on a voyage, a common fish that is both freshwater and saltwater is how they did this.
witchmod.compendium.army.desc: A blessing that turns aggressive mobs into your friends and makes them attack and protect you from anyone or anything that attacks you.
witchmod.compendium.army.rumour: Legends speak of a figure able to command the masses of undead mobs to their will, I could cast this using a common, protective tool.
witchmod.compendium.audit.desc: This realistic curse makes it so being near valuables has a chance for a tax man to enter and take a cut of some loot, if taxed the curse will be removed. There is probably a blessing that can return these taxes...
witchmod.compendium.audit.rumour: I've heard of laws where a higher being takes valuables in exchange for care, only to not do so, perhaps the currency of this game is what is needed to summon such creatures.
witchmod.compendium.backseat_driver.desc: This curse makes mounts occasionally take control of themselves and do what they want... which is usually not good.
witchmod.compendium.backseat_driver.rumo: There's a way to make mounts override the will of their owners, cast using the means of which to ride said mounts.
witchmod.compendium.backstabbing.desc: A blessing that doubles your damage on mobs and players from behind.
witchmod.compendium.backstabbing.rumour: Texts speak of a blessing used by assassins to strike foes down from behind, which seems to be cast using a brick from another dimension.
witchmod.compendium.bad_swimmer.desc: People with this curse find themselves unable to swim and sink in water.
witchmod.compendium.bad_swimmer.rumour: I heard of a way to remove someone's ability to swim, represented by a metal prone to oxidisation.
witchmod.compendium.basement_dweller.des: A curse that makes you the average gacha player; You take damage by going outside.
witchmod.compendium.basement_dweller.rum: There's a curse for some and a trait for others that makes them fear the outside world, I think I could cast this using a symbolic block that paints the outside world, one they may fear to touch.
witchmod.compendium.bedrock_moment.desc: A game-breaking curse that plagues the game with many different bugs, advertisements and other annoyances, these can be simple rubberbands or elaborate 'bugs' like charged creepers in boats paying them a visit. Incredibly excessive and annoying.
witchmod.compendium.bedrock_moment.rumou: Ancient texts speak of an inferior version of a game, with bugs, microtransactions and less freedom, perhaps I could channel that energy into a powerful hex, I just need a particular block known to cry.
witchmod.compendium.berserker.desc: A blessing that decreases the hit cooldown the more melee hits you succeed in a row, missing resets this reduction and it decays if you haven't hit for a while.
witchmod.compendium.berserker.rumour: Texts speak of magic that can turn your fury into stamina, increasing your swing speed, a heavy, reliable but inexpensive weapon is what could be used for this.
witchmod.compendium.bewitching_table.des:
The main workstation for casting blessings/curses onto a target. The table has 4 slots:

Cursed Essence - The currency/investment, the more of the cursed essence item you invest the higher chance the spell is cast successfully.

Sacrificial Item - The item that selects the curse/blessing. Not all items can be used here and the slot will turn red if invalid, you can view the rumours in the curses/blessings section of this compendium to find out what items cast what spells.

The Target - This slot decides who the spell will target. If left empty it will always target the one casting the spell, you can also put in someone's player essence (see items to see how to retrieve) or similarly a voodoo doll, which will use some durability.

Modifer - An optional slot that could add additional effects.
witchmod.compendium.blacksmith.desc: A blessing that increases your smithing skills; decreasing anvil XP costs and removing the too expensive limit.
witchmod.compendium.blacksmith.rumour: I heard a rumour about a blessing that makes smithing cheaper and easier, a once useless (and still kinda useless in this version) metal block is used to accomplish this.
witchmod.compendium.blessed_coin.desc: A magic coin imbued with mystical energy. Flipping it bestows 1-3 random blessings.
witchmod.compendium.bloodhound.desc: A tracking blessing, that makes nearby mobs and players leave 'scent trails' where they have walked.
witchmod.compendium.bloodhound.rumour: Hunters used to cast an ancient blessing to hunt down deserters, along with a ferocious, scent tracking, beast, perhaps an egg of this creature could be used for this.
witchmod.compendium.body_swapping.desc: A curse that occasionally causes the victim to swap places with players in their proximity.
witchmod.compendium.body_swapping.rumour: Rumours speak of a spell that made people uncontrollably swap places with others, cast using a 'fruit of teleportation'.
witchmod.compendium.bodyguard.desc: Makes a bodyguard follow you around and protect you from any threats, pushing away any nearby entities and being overconfident in chat to everyone nearby.
witchmod.compendium.bodyguard.rumour: Rumours speak of a blessing that employs a personal strongman to protect you, cast using an item that can tame a certain creature.
witchmod.compendium.bouncy.desc: This curse makes the victim very bouncy, being loud and bouncing off many surfaces and mobs.
witchmod.compendium.bouncy.rumour: There was an old blessing that is now seen as a curse that eliminated the effects of gravity by making the victim super bouncy and slimy.
witchmod.compendium.broken_bonds.desc: A curse centered around breaking the bonds of victim's tamed pets; spending time near tamed animals increasingly makes them irritated and they will eventually untame and run away.
witchmod.compendium.broken_bonds.rumour: There's a curse that can break even the strongest of human to animal bonds, represented by an item used to keep animals in place.
witchmod.compendium.brute.desc: This blessing makes your sprint charge up into a Juggernaut charge, where you can run through mobs and into walls and resist all knockback.
witchmod.compendium.brute.rumour: I heard of a blessing that turns you into a budget Juggernaut, a strong but inexpensive helmet is what I've heard casts this.
witchmod.compendium.builder.desc: A blessing that removes the vanilla delay between placing and breaking blocks, making it very fast to build and mine - but this can be inconvient at times.
witchmod.compendium.builder.rumour: There seems to be a blessing that removes a foundational feature from mining and building, likely the most prominent and common building material seems to be used to cast this.
witchmod.compendium.butterfingers.desc: A curse that makes the victim likely to drop the item they are holding on occasion.
witchmod.compendium.butterfingers.rumour: I heard of a spell to make victims carelessly drop their belongings, maybe something that can be churned into butter is what I need here...
witchmod.compendium.carelessness.desc: Your health bar becomes unreadable where every heart is pure black — though your real health is unchanged.
witchmod.compendium.carelessness.rumour: Legends speak of a hex that makes someone careless of their current health, casting using a dark tint of wool.
witchmod.compendium.channels.desc: A confusing curse that swaps left and right audio channels around, making using headphones confusing.
witchmod.compendium.channels.rumour: I've heard stories of a curse that breaks someone's sense of direction, which was accomplished using an instrumental block.
witchmod.compendium.chat.desc: This blessing makes you stream your gameplay to a very normal audience, where their retention is based on your gameplay and actions, higher viewcounts provide you with more subs and subs give you a payout of emeralds once this blessing ends.
witchmod.compendium.chat.rumour: There seems to be some sort of blessing that gives you more money than others for just pretending to be someone you're not... Wool tinted like the most popular streaming website is what I need to cast this.
witchmod.compendium.claustrophobia.desc: This curse makes the victim take ramping tick damage when covered by a roof.
witchmod.compendium.claustrophobia.rumou: There's a curse that seems to damage people in enclosed spaces, cast with cobblestone from the deep.
witchmod.compendium.clumsy.desc: Blocks you place occasionally come out wrong: mis-rotated, one block off from where you aimed, or a different block from your hotbar.
witchmod.compendium.clumsy.rumour: There's a slightly inconvenient curse that makes building much more difficult; Something some people race with using a spoon is what I need for this.
witchmod.compendium.coins.desc: Gamble coins are a special ritual exemption — flip one and let fate decide. The Cursed Coin rolls a random curse or blessing onto you; the Blessed Coin grants a random blessing; the Executioner's Coin revives you from death but leaves a random curse behind. You can also bottle a coin's roll into a jar at the Ritual Table.
witchmod.compendium.coins.name: Gamble Coins
witchmod.compendium.collector.desc: A blessing that pulls nearby stray items and experience towards you.
witchmod.compendium.collector.rumour: There seems to be a spell that makes you a magnet, with texts suggesting it is cast using a less utilised container.
witchmod.compendium.comic_relief.desc: A curse of pure 'bad luck'. If victims find themselves low on health or items all over the floor they may find themselves struck by a comedically-timed lightning bolt.
witchmod.compendium.comic_relief.rumour: I've seen footage of people getting smitten at unfortunate moments, I could replicate this with an item that attracts lightning.
witchmod.compendium.compendium.desc: A book that details your blessing and curse discoveries, as well as tutorials and descriptions for items and blocks included in this mod.
witchmod.compendium.confusion.desc: This blessing makes you produce clones that attack the nearby mobs, making it very confusing to fight, these die instantly and do minimal damage.
witchmod.compendium.confusion.rumour: Rumours speak of a blessing able to produce clones of people, perhaps the hide of a skiddish creature could be used here.
witchmod.compendium.cow.desc: This blessing lets you and others milk you using a bucket?
witchmod.compendium.cow.rumour: I heard of a way to make others... milkable for some reason... why? I could probably cast this using a common material associated with cows.
witchmod.compendium.coyote.desc: A weak blessing that increases your coyote time when off blocks and pulls you towards blocks when midair, attempting to make you better at parkour.
witchmod.compendium.coyote.rumour: There's a blessing that seems to loosely help with parkour, a food rationed by a particular old society seems to be the item for this.
witchmod.compendium.cursed_coin.desc: A magic coin imbued with cursed energy. Flipping it bestows 1-3 random curses, with a higher likelihood for more powerful curses.
witchmod.compendium.cursed_essence.desc: Mystical energy refined from amethyst. Used as a currency in rituals and for many crafting recipes.
witchmod.compendium.cursed_essence_block: A storage block for cursed essence. Can be used in the ritual table and counts as 9x cursed essence.
witchmod.compendium.cutaway_gag.desc: Victims of this curse will occasionally be pulled away from their actions to watch a cutaway gag created live using other random players, these gags are completely random and can be quite detrimental, or a useless waste of time.
witchmod.compendium.cutaway_gag.rumour: I've heard of shows that often use side stories for humour, I wanna try something like this, even if I'm not funny, I just need some sort of item that allows me to see from far distances...
witchmod.compendium.delusions.desc: This curse makes victims constantly see fake players roaming around and interacting with them, only they can see these players.
witchmod.compendium.delusions.rumour: I've heard of a curse that makes people see people who aren't real, I think this is castable using a throwable item, with the power of the End.
witchmod.compendium.dense.desc: You fall faster and crater the ground on hard landings, and any floor with air beneath it gives way if you loiter on it.
witchmod.compendium.dense.rumour: There's a curse that makes people significantly heavier, I think I could take the properties for this from a dense metal block.
witchmod.compendium.dexterous.desc: With this blessing, you find dexterity-based tasks significantly easier: Animations like eating and using bows are significantly easier: Crossbow enchantments like multishot have tighter spread and all arrows can hit one target.
witchmod.compendium.dexterous.rumour: There's a way to greatly enhance your dexterity, a special kind of arrow is said to be used for this.
witchmod.compendium.disguise.desc: A blessing that makes you look like an animal to others (including hostile entities), getting too close to a hostile mob or getting hit breaks this disguise temporarily.
witchmod.compendium.disguise.rumour: There's a way to make yourself pass as an animal to others using a common item, similar to a mannequin.
witchmod.compendium.drive.desc: Your presence with this blessing increases the drive of nearby animals for... some reason? This completely removes the breeding cooldown and makes villagers more likely to breed.
witchmod.compendium.drive.rumour: Questionable texts speak of a way to make breeding animals much more... intense. The sacrifice is said to be a common vegetable, encrusted with gold.
witchmod.compendium.dwarfism.desc: A curse that makes the victim significantly smaller and have less health, but due to their size, they can now ride players and villagers.
witchmod.compendium.dwarfism.rumour: There seems to be a shrinking curse; cast using an egg of a creature that is born very small.
witchmod.compendium.echoes.desc: Victims of this curse can't help but hear sounds that aren't real or chats that aren't real.
witchmod.compendium.echoes.rumour: There's a way to channel the power of sculk, to give people auditory delusions, something that echoes is what I can use here.
witchmod.compendium.effigy.desc: A magic artefact that allows you to forward all your active blessings and curses to another player at the exact times and stages. You must be very close to do this and it breaks on success.
witchmod.compendium.enchanter.desc: A blessing that makes you more proficient with magic, cheapening enchant costs and removing some of the more useless vanilla enchantments from being applied at the table.
witchmod.compendium.enchanter.rumour: Legends speak of a way to increase your enchanting skills using the main currency for enchanting.
witchmod.compendium.excavation.desc: A blessing intended for digging out large areas quickly; The more blocks you break in a small window increase your mining speed.
witchmod.compendium.excavation.rumour: Texts speak of a blessing used by ancient miners to mine out large areas quickly. I think I could cast this with a common, but reliable pickaxe.
witchmod.compendium.executioners_coin.de: An ancient coin imbued with mysterious energy. Flipping it can grant up to 1-3 random blessings or curses.
witchmod.compendium.farmers_spirit.desc: This blessing makes nearby foliage and crops grow quickly around you in a small radius.
witchmod.compendium.farmers_spirit.rumou: Rumours speak of a blessing able to enhance the growth speeds of nearby plants, a common plant, exclusively grown in villages, could be used for this.
witchmod.compendium.farmhand.desc: Nearby passive animals find themselves drawn to the victim and can't help but get in their way.
witchmod.compendium.farmhand.rumour: Rumours discuss a curse able to strongly attract farm animals to the victim; Maybe I could cast this using a basic farm product.
witchmod.compendium.filled_jars.desc: Cursed, Blessed and Mixed jars hold up to three curses/blessings. Throw one to splash its contents onto whoever it hits. You fill an empty jar at a Ritual Table using sacrificial items (or a coin), and named jars turn up as loot.
witchmod.compendium.filled_jars.name: Filled Jars
witchmod.compendium.flat_footed.desc: Makes you a very clumsy walker; You footsteps are very loud and shake the camera of people nearby, even while crouched.
witchmod.compendium.flat_footed.rumour: I've heard that I can make people walk a lot louder, some loud 'instrument' is what I need to replicate this.
witchmod.compendium.flight.desc: A blessing that lets you fly on a resource, where taking damage uses some of this resource. By not sprinting you will surge up quicker and sprint-flying will increase your horizontal movement, this can also be used in tandem with elytra.
witchmod.compendium.flight.rumour: Rumours suggest I don't need to say this one its in the name. Tears of a flying beast are used to cast this.
witchmod.compendium.floor_is_lava.desc: Standing still for too long with this curse starts to deal tick damage.
witchmod.compendium.floor_is_lava.rumour: There's a way to replicate the effect of magma; Giving idle people hot feet, there's a clear block I can use here.
witchmod.compendium.forgiveness.desc: Makes Minecraft a bit more forgiving; Hitboxes for entities are increased for you, making melee, or projectile hits much easier.
witchmod.compendium.forgiveness.rumour: Rumours speak of a blessing that changes the very foundations of the game in your favour, the item is said to be able to name creatures.
witchmod.compendium.fortune.desc: Adds an extra layer of fortune when mining your ores, giving you 1-3 extra items from mining ores, this stacks with fortune enchantments.
witchmod.compendium.fortune.rumour: Legends speak of a way to further increase your fortune past enchantments, cast using a once rare ore.
witchmod.compendium.fullness.desc: A blessing that slows your metabolism to a halt, making it so you don't get hungry for the entire duration.
witchmod.compendium.fullness.rumour: Rumours suggest a blessing able to suppress your appetite, a hearty, cheap food is said to be used to cast this.
witchmod.compendium.gassy.desc: A very funny curse that makes the victim uncontrollably fart occasionally, loud sounds or damage can also scare them into farting, launching the victim.
witchmod.compendium.gassy.rumour: Rumours speak of impulsive and childish curse, castable using a creature able to inflate itself.
witchmod.compendium.giant.desc: A curse that makes the victim enormous and slow, but makes them able to stomp on entities and have increased swing range.
witchmod.compendium.giant.rumour: I've seen drawings of individuals at a huge size, lumbering, but able stomp and attack freely. I think common seeds of a plant is what I need here.
witchmod.compendium.gladiator.desc: A gimmick that makes it so (when not holding a shield!) you are able to parry, if hit during a parry you automatically riposte, dealing high knockback, bonus damage and restoring your weapon and parry cooldown.
witchmod.compendium.gladiator.rumour: There is a blessing out there that allows you to block and retaliate against attacks you foresee, I heard it is cast using a sword comprised of a rare, soft metal.
witchmod.compendium.glass_cannon.desc: A curse that increases the damage you receive substantially but also increases the damage you deal significantly.
witchmod.compendium.glass_cannon.rumour: There's a curse that can increase someone's strength, at the cost of making them more fragile. There's a clear suitable block for this...
witchmod.compendium.gluttony.desc: Gives the victim an additional hunger bar and a bigger appetite and body, they also take bigger bites of food.
witchmod.compendium.gluttony.rumour: Texts speak of a way to increase someone's appetite significantly; Represented by a food associated with gluttony.
witchmod.compendium.guardian_angel.desc: A blessing that provides the player with your very own guardian angel. This angel helps you with tasks, lighting up areas and combat by dealing damage, stunning, blinding and highlighting the strongest enemy, highlighted enemies take extra damage from you. This angel can be killed.
witchmod.compendium.guardian_angel.rumou: Legends speak of an ancient blessing, bestowing a kind and helpful spirit onto someone, this spirit is said to like fruits and gold.
witchmod.compendium.haunted.desc: This curse haunts the victim with a well-modeled entity only they can see, this mysterious entity does not want to be looked at and paying any attention to its presence makes it angrier. If this entity touches the victim, they die instantly.
witchmod.compendium.haunted.rumour: I heard of a mod that mistakes horror for adrenaline, with poor design and frustrating outcomes. I could poorly replicate it using a certain entity, which frequently counters creatures from these rumoured mods.
witchmod.compendium.hawk_guy.desc: Shows others that purple's not that funny (whatever that means) by making your projectiles home in on the nearest target you are looking at.
witchmod.compendium.hawk_guy.rumour: Legends speak of a blessing that can make you into the coolest avenger, using a block with a bullseye.
witchmod.compendium.heavy_hitter.desc: Your melee hits have slightly increased damage and knock targets back about twice as far, stacking with the Knockback enchantment.
witchmod.compendium.heavy_hitter.rumour: People speak of a way to enhance the weight of your swings, a heavy weapon could be used to represent this.
witchmod.compendium.hiccups.desc: A curse that makes the victim hiccup constantly, hiccups disrupt movement briefly and are overall annoying.
witchmod.compendium.hiccups.rumour: I heard of a curse that interrupts movement with impulsive actions, which is cast using a prevalent and easy to consume food.
witchmod.compendium.holy_water.recipe_no: Not crafted. Imbue a cauldron of water with amethyst shards to convert it into Holy Water.
witchmod.compendium.homebody.desc: A blessing that makes you very comfortable within your home, giving you regeneration and haste when near your spawnpoint.
witchmod.compendium.homebody.rumour: I heard of a blessing that can turn homely comfort into strength, the most basic and well-known variation of a bed is how I cast this.
witchmod.compendium.hot_stuff.desc: You become smoking hot with this blessing, making any active furnace you look at start smelting at a greatly increased speed.
witchmod.compendium.hot_stuff.rumour: Texts speak of a blessing that assists with smelting, there is a clear item, most commonly used for smelting that I could use here.
witchmod.compendium.hype_man.desc: A good blessing for lonely people: Forces nearby players to praise your actions (and looks!) in chat, which makes you feel good and buffs you.
witchmod.compendium.hype_man.rumour: Political texts speak of a power to make those, even if they hate you, speak your name and praise you needlessly, cast using the power of music to cast this.
witchmod.compendium.ice_skates.desc: This curse reduces the victim's friction, making them slide around like everything is ice.
witchmod.compendium.ice_skates.rumour: There's a curse that makes the victim lose all friction; I think this is castable using a slightly more dense form of ice.
witchmod.compendium.immortality.desc: Upon death, this blessing allows you to revive yourself up to 3 times, with a small, increasing time to revive per death. You still drop your items on death.
witchmod.compendium.immortality.rumour: There are legends of an ancient spell, able to allow you to rebuild yourself after death, the remains of the creature of decay are said to be used to cast this.
witchmod.compendium.infectious.desc: A modifier (Slime Ball), not a curse: it makes the target's attachments contagious, spreading to whoever they touch.
witchmod.compendium.insomniac.desc: This curse makes the victim unable to sleep.
witchmod.compendium.insomniac.rumour: Rumours talk about a way to keep people awake, maybe a product of a creature that plagues those who have not slept is how I can cast this.
witchmod.compendium.intro.blessings.text:
Blessings are a usually positive affliction that could have some negative aspects.

Up to 3 blessings can be on a person at once (regardless of any curses) and usually last between 30-60 minutes.

Each blessing has a specific item used to cast it that rumours hint towards, once discovered a full description for a blessing and the item needed will always be listed in this section.

The power level is a loose representation of how powerful the blessing is and how expensive it is, where higher power is more expensive and usually more beneficial.
witchmod.compendium.intro.blocks.text: There are a few blocks that interact with the magic system, their recipes and purposes are always described in this section.
witchmod.compendium.intro.blocks.title: Blocks
witchmod.compendium.intro.curses.text:
Curses are a usually negative affliction that could have some positive aspects.

Up to 3 curses can be on a person at once (regardless of any blessings) and usually last between 30-60 minutes.

Each curse has a specific item used to cast it that rumours hint towards, once discovered a full description for a curse and the item needed will always be listed in this section.

The power level is a loose representation of how detrimental the curse is and how expensive it is, where higher power is more expensive and usually more annoying or detrimental.
witchmod.compendium.intro.curses.title: Curses
witchmod.compendium.intro.items.text: There a specific items that can be used in particular ways to interact with curses and blessings, or interact with others in other ways (voodoo magic). Their recipes and descriptions are always described in this section.
witchmod.compendium.intro.items.title: Items
witchmod.compendium.intro.modifiers.text:
Modifiers are specific items you can attach to a cast curse/blessing for yield a particular effect, like increasing time, decreasing costs, making it infectious and so on. These work on a rumour to discovery system like curses and blessings and their effects usually impact the cost.
